66339.recognize_zh: 背景大量紅血球含細小環狀體、雙染色質點與多重感染，顯示高寄生率的惡性瘧（P. falciparum）；左下三顆聚集的中性球中，可在其中一顆細胞質邊緣看到小的黑褐色瘧色素（hemozoin）顆粒，但本視野色素量很少。
features: High parasitemia with numerous delicate small ring forms, many red cells containing two or more rings
Double chromatin dots and marginal appliqué forms in normal-sized red cells without stippling
Cluster of three segmented neutrophils; one shows a small dark brown-black cytoplasmic granule consistent with hemozoin
Pigment is scant in this field, and other neutrophils show only normal fine granules
A single pale bluish-grey red cell (likely polychromatic) and scattered platelets
66339.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows heavy parasitemia with numerous small ring forms, frequent multiple infection of red cells, double chromatin dots and appliqué forms, without red cell enlargement or Schüffner stippling. A cluster of three segmented neutrophils is present, one of which contains a small dark brown-black cytoplasmic granule consistent with phagocytosed malarial pigment; pigment is scant in this field. No schizonts or gametocytes are identified. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with occasional pigment-containing neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Babesia rings lack hemozoin and may form tetrads, and patients typically have tick exposure without travel to malaria-endemic areas.
Early P. knowlesi rings can mimic falciparum, but later band forms and schizonts resemble P. malariae and PCR is needed.
Toxic granules are fine purple-black and diffuse across the cytoplasm rather than a few discrete refractile brown-black clumps.

ddx.dx: Howell-Jolly bodies or platelets overlying red cells
ddx.vs: These are solid round dots without the thin blue cytoplasmic ring that defines a trophozoite.

66211.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中只有兩顆血小板，且都明顯變大：左側一顆接近小紅血球大小、右側一顆也遠大於正常血小板，內含正常分布的紫紅顆粒；整個視野幾乎沒有正常大小的血小板，呈巨大血小板合併血小板減少的樣貌。
features: Two enlarged platelets: the left one approaching the diameter of an adjacent red cell, the right one also clearly larger than normal
Platelets contain evenly distributed azurophilic granules (not agranular or gray)
Marked paucity of platelets across the field, indicating thrombocytopenia
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis; no platelet clumps
No leukocytes in the field, so neutrophil inclusions cannot be assessed
66211.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows markedly decreased platelets, with the few platelets present being enlarged, including one approaching red-cell size, and retaining normal azurophilic granulation. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis, and no platelet clumping is identified. Leukocytes are not present in this field to assess for Döhle-like inclusions. Findings of macrothrombocytopenia are consistent with an inherited giant platelet disorder such as Bernard-Soulier syndrome, to be confirmed by absent ristocetin-induced aggregation and reduced CD42b/GPIb expression by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: ITP platelets are large but rarely red-cell–sized, and ristocetin-induced aggregation and GPIb expression are normal.
Giant platelets are accompanied by Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils (not assessable in this field) and normal ristocetin response.
Gray platelets are large and pale/agranular because of absent alpha granules, unlike these granulated platelets.
Morphology is similar with mild or no bleeding; distinction requires GPIb-IX-V flow cytometry and genetic testing.

65955.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆無核的圓形細胞，大小約等於周圍紅血球，細胞質充滿細紫色顆粒且邊緣呈毛邊狀，明顯大於右上方的一般血小板，為巨大血小板（giant platelet）。
features: Anucleate cell in the center approximately equal in diameter to surrounding red cells
Cytoplasm diffusely filled with fine purple azurophilic granules
Round shape with fine fringed, slightly spiculated margin
Normal-sized small platelets present elsewhere for comparison
Normochromic, normocytic red cells without schistocytes; no leukocytes in the field
65955.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic, normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis. In the center of the field is an anucleate granular platelet approximately the size of an adjacent red cell, much larger than the few normal-sized platelets present. There is no nucleus, cytoplasmic rim, or evidence of platelet clumping. Findings are consistent with a giant platelet; its significance depends on the platelet count and the frequency of such forms (e.g., increased turnover, myeloproliferative neoplasm, or inherited macrothrombocytopenia).

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a dense round nucleus with a thin rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas this cell lacks a nucleus and is granular throughout.

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocyte or megakaryocyte nucleus in blood
ddx.vs: Circulating megakaryocytic cells contain a dense nucleus with a variable cytoplasmic rim, whereas a giant platelet is anucleate.
Clumps are composed of several aggregated platelets with visible individual outlines and cause pseudothrombocytopenia.
An overlying platelet lies within a red cell outline, often with a clear halo, rather than free on the background.

65571.recognize_zh: 周邊血中滿是中到大型淋巴球，核圓或略不規則、少數有凹痕，染色質中度濃縮，部分可見單一明顯核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍，這是 prolymphocyte 樣形態；需流式與 CCND1 檢測才知是被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Marked lymphocytosis of medium to large lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei, some notched or cleaved, occasional bilobed form
Moderately condensed chromatin with a single visible nucleolus in some cells
Moderate amount of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Relatively monomorphic population; no smudge cells in this field
65571.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in medium to large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei, some with notches or clefts, moderately condensed chromatin, a single visible nucleolus in a subset, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm, imparting a prolymphocytoid appearance. Smudge cells are not evident. The morphology is suggestive of a B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder with prolymphocytoid cells; with CD5-negative, kappa-restricted B cells and IGH::CCND1 fusion, findings are consistent with leukemic mantle cell lymphoma with prolymphocyte morphology.

ddx.vs: B-PLL cells look similar but lack cyclin D1/IGH::CCND1, so FISH or cyclin D1 immunostain is required to separate them.
CLL shows predominantly small lymphocytes with block-like chromatin, smudge cells, and a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype.
SMZL cells are smaller with polar villous cytoplasmic projections and lack CCND1 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant/splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: These cells have abundant cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and are CD11c+/CD103 variable, cyclin D1 negative by FISH.

65507.recognize_zh: 四格骨髓抹片分別看到核分離的巨核細胞、核出芽（nuclear budding）的紅血球母細胞、帶毒性顆粒的顆粒球與芽細胞，卻幾乎看不到 VEXAS 經典的前驅細胞空泡，符合以 MDS 表現為主的 UBA1 S56F 亞型。
features: Panel A: megakaryocyte with widely separated, non-lobated nuclei (dysmegakaryopoiesis)
Panel B: erythroid precursor with nuclear budding/irregular nuclear lobation (arrow)
Panel C: granulocyte with coarse toxic-type granules adjacent to a densely granulated precursor
Panel D: blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm (arrows)
Pertinent negative: no conspicuous cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid or erythroid precursors
65507.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show trilineage dysplastic and reactive changes. Megakaryocytes include forms with widely separated nuclei, and erythroid precursors show nuclear budding. Granulocytes contain coarse toxic granules, and scattered blasts with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm are present. Notably, prominent cytoplasmic vacuolization of myeloid and erythroid precursors is not seen. In conjunction with 5% blasts and a UBA1 S56F mutation, findings are consistent with VEXAS syndrome presenting as myelodysplastic neoplasm with increased blasts, with minimal vacuolization characteristic of the S56F subtype.

ddx.vs: Classic VEXAS shows prominent punched-out vacuoles in myeloid and erythroid precursors, which are largely absent here; the specific UBA1 variant is confirmed by sequencing.

ddx.dx: MDS with increased blasts without UBA1 mutation
ddx.vs: Dysplasia and blast count can be identical, so separation requires UBA1 sequencing and the autoinflammatory clinical picture.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open chromatin and giant metamyelocytes without increased blasts, and corrects with B12/folate.
These show precursor vacuolization and ring sideroblasts without clonal blast increase, and are identified by copper/zinc levels and exposure history.

65379.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片旁的空白區有一個半圓形分生孢子頭：中央圓形囊泡、周圍放射狀瓶梗，旁邊聚著棕黑色圓形分生孢子，這是麴菌（Aspergillus）的結構。
features: Partial (sectioned) conidial head with a central round vesicle and radiating phialides
Clusters of dark brown, round, rough-appearing conidia at the edge
Structure lies free in a clear area away from the tissue fragment
Adjacent marrow fragment with fat cells and scattered hematopoietic cells
No invasive hyphae or inflammation seen in this field
65379.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow section shows, adjacent to a fragment of fatty marrow with scattered hematopoietic cells, a sectioned conidial head of a fungus with a central vesicle, radiating phialides and clusters of dark brown round conidia. The structure lies free in a clear space, and no tissue-invasive hyphae or host inflammatory reaction are identified in this field. The fruiting structure is characteristic of Aspergillus species, with pigmented conidia suggesting the A. niger group. Given that conidiation is unusual in deep tissue, correlation with invasive hyphae elsewhere and culture is needed to exclude contamination.

ddx.dx: Contaminant from stain, water bath or slide
ddx.vs: Location outside tissue without invasive hyphae favors contamination; true invasive disease shows hyphae within tissue or vessels with necrosis.
Mucorales form broad pauciseptate ribbon-like hyphae and sporangia containing spores, not vesicles bearing phialides.
Pollen has a thick patterned exine wall and lacks radiating phialides with chains of conidia.

65315.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍中多顆大型組織球具有大量粉紅色、條紋狀像皺摺紙張的細胞質，核小而偏心，周圍為密集的顆粒球系細胞，是 CML 常見的假性高雪氏細胞。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm showing fibrillary, crumpled striations
Small eccentric round nuclei, some with small vacuoles in the cytoplasm
Histiocytes form loose clusters among hematopoietic cells
Background granulocytic cells including segmented neutrophils and myeloid precursors
Occasional larger hyperchromatic cells in the lower left corner
65315.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow trephine biopsy shows clusters of large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, fibrillary cytoplasm resembling crumpled tissue paper and small eccentric nuclei. The surrounding marrow is densely populated by granulocytic precursors and maturing neutrophils. No organisms or granulomas are seen. In the setting of BCR::ABL1-positive disease, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells in chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells look identical but occur without a myeloproliferative background and are confirmed by glucocerebrosidase deficiency.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes may appear striated but are Ziehl-Neelsen positive.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain coarse ceroid granules that are blue on Romanowsky stains rather than fibrillary pink cytoplasm on H&E.

65187.recognize_zh: 淋巴結呈模糊結節狀浸潤，結節周圍有大量漿細胞樣細胞與組織球，內含明亮嗜伊紅、多角形的免疫球蛋白結晶包涵體；CD5 與 cyclin D1 同時在淋巴細胞與漿細胞樣細胞陽性，MUM1 標記含包涵體的漿細胞，提示伴明顯漿細胞分化的被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Whole-mount lymph node with vaguely nodular lymphoid infiltrate and pale interfollicular/medullary areas (A)
Perinodular sheets of atypical plasmacytoid cells and histiocytes filled with glassy eosinophilic crystalline immunoglobulin inclusions (B, inset)
Small lymphoid cells CD20+ with weaker staining in plasmacytoid areas (C)
Diffuse CD5 positivity in the nodular lymphoid component (D)
Nuclear cyclin D1 in lymphoid cells and in plasma cells (E, inset)
MUM1-positive plasmacytoid cells, several containing clear crystalline intracytoplasmic inclusions (F, arrows)
65187.describe_en: The lymph node shows a vaguely nodular lymphoid infiltrate. Surrounding the nodules and expanding the medullary cords are sheets of atypical plasmacytoid cells and histiocytes containing abundant crystalline, eosinophilic immunoglobulin inclusions. The lymphoid cells are CD20 and CD5 positive with nuclear cyclin D1 expression, and cyclin D1 is also expressed by the MUM1-positive plasmacytoid cells that harbor the inclusions. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with marked plasmacytic differentiation and crystal-storing features; molecular confirmation of CCND1 rearrangement supports the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL commonly shows plasmacytic differentiation and crystal-storing histiocytes but is CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative.
LPL is usually CD5-negative, cyclin D1-negative and MYD88 L265P-mutated, typically IgM rather than IgA.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with CCND1 translocation (crystal-storing histiocytosis)
ddx.vs: Myeloma with t(11;14) lacks the CD20+/CD5+ small B-cell nodular component seen here.

ddx.dx: Small lymphocytic lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: SLL is CD5+ but CD23+/LEF1+ and cyclin D1-negative apart from proliferation centers.

65187.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD5, cyclin D1, MUM1

64995.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡影像中數個淋巴樣細胞的核呈明顯凹陷、分葉狀或有裂溝，細胞質少，細胞之間夾著成束的膠原纖維；核裂溝狀是濾泡性淋巴瘤中心細胞在超微結構上的表現。
features: Cluster of lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm with sparse organelles
Nuclei deeply indented, notched and lobulated with irregular cleavage planes
Heterochromatin clumped along the nuclear envelope; prominent nucleoli in a few cells
One cell (upper) with more cytoplasm containing small vesicles, possibly a histiocyte or larger lymphoid cell
Abundant interstitial collagen fibril bundles separating cells; an electron-dense cell at upper left
64995.describe_en: Transmission electron micrograph shows a group of lymphoid cells embedded in a collagen-rich interstitium. The cells have scant cytoplasm with few organelles and markedly irregular nuclei with deep indentations and cleavage planes, peripheral heterochromatin and occasional prominent nucleoli. No desmosomes, neurosecretory granules or stacked rough endoplasmic reticulum are identified. The findings are consistent with cleaved centrocyte-like lymphoma cells, in keeping with the reported follicular lymphoma; ultrastructure is supportive only and diagnosis rests on histology and immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are mixed with plasma cells and small round lymphocytes, and clonality (BCL2 expression in follicles, IGH::BCL2) cannot be judged by electron microscopy.
MCL nuclei may also be irregular, so cyclin D1 and CD5 immunostaining is needed to exclude it.
Plasma cells show abundant concentric rough endoplasmic reticulum and round eccentric nuclei rather than organelle-poor cytoplasm with cleaved nuclei.

65059.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中出現一團彼此黏聚（cohesive）的大型細胞，核大而圓、細胞質深藍帶小空泡，細胞間界線不清且互相擠壓，大小遠超過旁邊的顆粒球，提示非造血來源的轉移性癌細胞。
features: Cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells, many times larger than the adjacent neutrophil
High N:C ratio with large round-to-oval nuclei and nuclear crowding/molding
Finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small cytoplasmic vacuoles and indistinct cell borders
Background of scattered granulocytes and degenerated red cells
65059.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large atypical cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to oval nuclei with nuclear crowding, and deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. The cells are markedly larger than adjacent granulocytes and form a tight syncytial aggregate, a feature not typical of hematopoietic cells. In a patient with known lung adenocarcinoma, the findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow; confirmation on trephine biopsy with immunohistochemistry (e.g., cytokeratin, TTF-1) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have single lobulated nuclei and abundant granular pink cytoplasm, not multiple discrete round nuclei in a cohesive sheet.
Osteoblasts are loosely arranged with eccentric nuclei and a pale perinuclear hof away from the nucleus, lacking the nuclear crowding and molding seen here.
Hematolymphoid cells are generally discohesive and form clumps only artifactually; cytokeratin positivity and CD45 negativity confirm carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor (e.g., small cell carcinoma, neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Small cell tumors show smaller cells with scant cytoplasm and prominent nuclear molding, whereas these cells have more abundant vacuolated cytoplasm favoring adenocarcinoma.

64739.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD138 染色中，棕色膜狀陽性的漿細胞在造血細胞與脂肪之間呈單顆或小群散佈，約佔細胞量一成多，比正常（<5%）明顯增加，但未形成大片集落。
features: Scattered CD138-positive plasma cells with membranous and cytoplasmic staining
Interstitial distribution as single cells and small clusters, without large sheets
Positive cells estimated at roughly 10-15% of cellularity in this field
CD138-negative hematopoietic background with blue counterstain between adipocytes
64739.describe_en: CD138 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine highlights an increased number of plasma cells distributed interstitially as single cells and small clusters. Positive cells represent approximately 10-15% of marrow cellularity in this field, without large confluent sheets. The remaining hematopoietic elements are CD138 negative. In a patient with an extramedullary plasmacytoma, the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm, and kappa/lambda studies should be performed to confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are often perivascular and show a mixed kappa and lambda population; morphology alone on CD138 cannot separate them.

ddx.dx: Solitary plasmacytoma with minimal marrow involvement
ddx.vs: Minimal marrow involvement is defined as clonal plasma cells below 10%, so accurate enumeration across the whole core with light-chain restriction determines the category.
This would show an accompanying CD20-positive lymphoid infiltrate sharing the same light chain.

64675.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片拼圖中多為核偏位、細胞質深藍且有核周淡染區（hof）的漿細胞，其中數顆細胞含兩個大小相近的細胞核（雙核漿細胞），部分核內可見淡色圓形包涵體與小核仁。
features: Numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Several binucleated plasma cells with two similar-sized nuclei in abundant blue cytoplasm
Coarse clock-face to moderately clumped chromatin; small nucleoli visible in some nuclei
Occasional pale round intranuclear/overlying inclusions, compatible with Dutcher bodies, and a cell with multiple clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Plasma cells form clusters with scattered granulocytes and red cells in the background
64675.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (composite) shows increased plasma cells, many in clusters, with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs. Several binucleated plasma cells are present, some with visible nucleoli, and occasional cells contain pale round inclusions overlying the nucleus (compatible with Dutcher bodies) or multiple cytoplasmic vacuoles. Scattered granulocytes are seen in the background. The prominence of clustered, binucleated and nucleolated plasma cells is suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm; quantitation, CD138 immunostaining and light-chain restriction are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, scattered or perivascular, rarely clustered, and polytypic, whereas clustered nucleolated and binucleated plasma cells favor clonality confirmed by kappa/lambda restriction.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with mast cells, and MYD88 L265P, rather than a predominant sheet of plasma cells.
Plasmablasts have larger nuclei with dispersed chromatin, prominent central nucleoli and high N:C ratio, more immature than these mostly mature-appearing plasma cells.
Osteoblasts are larger with eccentric nuclei and a hof placed away from the nucleus and occur in small clusters in pediatric/regenerating marrow, and are not binucleated plasma cells.

64547.recognize_zh: X 光見肘後鷹嘴處軟組織腫脹（箭頭）；H&E 為成片大型異型細胞，可見核呈腎形或馬蹄形、核旁有嗜酸性區的 hallmark cell；CD30 瀰漫強陽性，FISH 顯示 IRF4/DUSP22 分離訊號，符合 ALK 陰性 ALCL。
features: Panel A: lateral elbow radiograph with prominent posterior soft-tissue swelling over the olecranon (arrowhead), without bony destruction
Panel B: sheets of large discohesive atypical cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and vesicular chromatin
Panel B inset: hallmark cell with eccentric kidney/horseshoe-shaped nucleus and paranuclear eosinophilic region
Panel C: strong, diffuse membranous and Golgi CD30 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Panel D: IRF4/DUSP22 break-apart FISH with separated red and green signals
64547.describe_en: Lateral radiograph of the right elbow shows marked soft-tissue swelling over the olecranon without evident bone involvement (panel A). Sections of the bursal tissue show sheets of large, discohesive atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, including hallmark cells with eccentric horseshoe-shaped nuclei (panel B). The tumor cells are strongly and uniformly CD30 positive (panel C), and FISH with an IRF4/DUSP22 break-apart probe shows split signals (panel D). With the reported ALK-negative, CD2+/CD43+/MUM1+ T-cell phenotype and clonal TCRB rearrangement, findings are consistent with ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma with DUSP22 rearrangement involving the olecranon bursa.

ddx.vs: ALK-positive ALCL shares hallmark cells and CD30 positivity but expresses ALK protein, which is negative here.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous ALCL or breast implant-associated ALCL
ddx.vs: These are defined by skin or peri-implant seroma location respectively, and clinical staging excluded cutaneous disease and implant history.
DLBCL expresses PAX5, CD20, and CD79a, all negative in this tumor.
Carcinoma and melanoma are cytokeratin or S100/SOX10 positive and lack CD30 with T-cell markers and clonal TCR rearrangement.

64547.stain: X-ray; H&E; IHC: CD30; FISH: IRF4/DUSP22

64483.recognize_zh: 小型細胞的核分裂成兩塊邊緣平滑、染色極深的濃縮團塊，中間以淡染區隔開，細胞質少並帶小空泡，符合凋亡淋巴球的核濃縮與碎裂。
features: Small cell (about 8-9 µm), roughly red-cell sized
Nucleus broken into two smooth-contoured, densely condensed dark fragments
Pale clear zone separating the chromatin fragments
Scant blue-grey cytoplasm with small vacuoles and slightly irregular border
Background red cells include target-like and teardrop forms
64483.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cell whose nucleus is split into two dense, homogeneously dark, smooth-contoured fragments separated by a pale zone, with scant blue-grey vacuolated cytoplasm. Chromatin detail and nucleoli are not appreciable. In the setting of cladribine therapy for hairy cell leukemia, the cell is consistent with an apoptotic lymphocyte showing nuclear condensation and fragmentation.

ddx.vs: A viable lymphocyte keeps a visible clumped chromatin pattern and an intact nuclear membrane rather than homogeneous, glassy dense fragments.
Neutrophils are larger with pink cytoplasm containing specific granules and lobes joined by chromatin strands.
Hairy cells are larger with oval or bean-shaped nuclei, open ground-glass chromatin, and abundant cytoplasm with circumferential projections.

64419.recognize_zh: 抹片中的淋巴球核圓或卵圓、染色質均勻，細胞質豐富淡藍並有毛狀突起；切片呈「荷包蛋」樣間隔排列，TRAP、CD123、cyclin D1、Annexin A1 陽性但 BRAF 陰性，流式 CD25+/CD11c+ 而 CD103 陰性，仍符合毛細胞白血病。
features: Smear (A): medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections
H&E (B): diffuse infiltrate of evenly spaced cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei and clear to pale cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance)
IHC: strong CD20 (C), TRAP (D), CD123 (E), weak nuclear cyclin D1 (F) and Annexin A1 (L) positive; BRAF V600E (G) negative
Flow: absent monocyte cluster on CD45/SSC (H); CD19+ CD25+ (I); CD11c+ with CD103 negative (J); kappa light chain restriction (K)
64419.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections. The core biopsy shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of evenly spaced cells with bean-shaped nuclei and pale cytoplasm. By immunohistochemistry, the cells are positive for CD20, TRAP, CD123, cyclin D1 (weak), and annexin A1, but negative for BRAF V600E. Flow cytometry shows monocytopenia and a kappa-restricted B-cell population expressing CD19, CD25, and CD11c without CD103. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia with an unusual BRAF-negative, CD103-negative phenotype.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v has prominent nucleoli, lacks CD25, annexin A1, TRAP and CD123, and has no monocytopenia, whereas these cells are CD25+ and annexin A1+.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have villous cytoplasm but are CD25-, CD123-, annexin A1-negative with intrasinusoidal marrow pattern.
SMZL cells show polar short villi, nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow involvement, and are negative for annexin A1, CD103, and usually CD25/CD123.
Mantle cell lymphoma shows strong cyclin D1 with CD5 expression and lacks TRAP, CD25, CD11c and annexin A1 together with hairy cytoplasm.

64419.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E; IHC panel; flow cytometry

64355.recognize_zh: 中央約八到十顆白血球（多為嗜中性球，含一顆單核樣細胞）緊密黏成一團；周圍紅血球也聚成不規則大片狀，這是體外白血球聚集（leukoagglutination）的表現，會造成白血球計數假性偏低。
features: Tight cluster of about 8-10 leukocytes, predominantly segmented neutrophils, in the center of the field
Individual cells within the clump retain normal nuclear lobation and granular cytoplasm
Red cells aggregated into large irregular, branching masses (agglutinates) rather than a monolayer
Occasional isolated leukocyte at the periphery of the clump
No platelet aggregates or organisms clearly seen
64355.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a tight aggregate of leukocytes, mainly segmented neutrophils, with preserved individual nuclear and cytoplasmic morphology. The red cells in the background form large irregular, interconnected masses rather than a dispersed monolayer. No platelet clumps or intracellular organisms are evident. Findings are consistent with in vitro leukocyte clumping (leukoagglutination), accompanied by red cell aggregation; automated WBC counts may be spuriously low and should be verified on a smear or a sample collected in an alternative anticoagulant or kept warm.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps show a pale granular platelet matrix surrounding the white cells, whereas this aggregate is composed of leukocytes directly abutting one another.

ddx.dx: Tumor cell clusters (e.g., circulating carcinoma cells)
ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters show cohesive large cells with high N:C ratio, nucleoli and molding, unlike mature segmented neutrophils with normal granules.
Cold agglutinins cause red cell clumping that disperses on warming, but they do not explain aggregation of the leukocytes themselves; correlate with direct antiglobulin test for C3d.

64163.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，在含鐵血黃素棕色顆粒與紅系前驅細胞之間，散在較大的上皮樣細胞，核大、泡狀、形狀不規則、核仁不明顯，細胞質淡染至粉紅；本例經 CD163 證實為組織球而非轉移癌。
features: Hypercellular marrow with scattered large epithelioid cells showing enlarged, oval to irregular vesicular nuclei and inconspicuous nucleoli
Epithelioid cells have moderate to abundant pale/clear to lightly eosinophilic cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Abundant coarse golden-brown pigment (hemosiderin) within macrophages
Background of erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei and myeloid cells between adipocytes
No discrete cohesive glandular nests or desmoplasia evident in this field
64163.describe_en: High-power view of an H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with maturing erythroid and myeloid elements and abundant hemosiderin-laden macrophages. Interspersed are large epithelioid cells with pleomorphic vesicular nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli, and pale to pink cytoplasm, which form a loose focal aggregate rather than cohesive glands. On H&E alone these cells raise concern for metastatic carcinoma; however, in this case they showed only dot-like cytoplasmic keratin staining with membranous CD163 positivity, supporting an epithelioid histiocytic aggregate in a marrow with MDS. The epithelioid focus is not sharply delineated at this magnification, so correlation with the lower-power and immunostained panels is required.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with strong diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous keratin and is CD163/CD68 negative, whereas these cells show only dot-like keratin and membranous CD163.
Granulomas are compact with elongated slipper-shaped nuclei, multinucleated giant cells, and a lymphoid cuff, and warrant AFB/fungal stains.
Mast cell aggregates contain spindled or oval cells with pale granular cytoplasm, often paratrabecular or perivascular with eosinophils and fibrosis, and are CD117/tryptase positive.
Megakaryocytes are larger with lobulated or hypolobated hyperchromatic nuclei and are CD61/CD42b positive.

64099.recognize_zh: 脊椎矢狀切 MRI 在上胸椎位置可見一顆邊界清楚、訊號不均勻的圓形軟組織腫塊，緊鄰椎體與脊椎管；在 APL 病人身上，這種髓外軟組織腫塊代表顆粒性肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma），確診仍須切片。
features: Sagittal MRI of the thoracolumbar spine, fat-suppressed sequence (likely post-contrast)
Well-circumscribed, rounded, heterogeneous soft-tissue mass at the upper thoracic level adjacent to the vertebral column
Mass abuts the spinal canal region; degree of cord compression cannot be judged confidently on this single slice
Prominent tortuous enhancing vessels along the lower thoracic and lumbar canal
Non-morphologic image: radiology cannot determine tissue type
64099.describe_en: Sagittal fat-suppressed MRI of the thoracolumbar spine shows a well-circumscribed, rounded, heterogeneous soft-tissue mass at the upper thoracic level adjacent to the vertebral column and spinal canal. Prominent tortuous vascular structures are seen along the lower spinal canal. The single slice and sequence limit assessment of cord compression and marrow signal. Imaging is not tissue-specific; in a patient with acute promyelocytic leukemia, the mass is consistent with an extramedullary myeloid sarcoma, which should be confirmed by biopsy showing MPO/CD33-positive myeloid cells and PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma (e.g., DLBCL) of the spine or paraspinal tissue
ddx.vs: Biopsy distinguishes it: lymphoma shows CD20+ or CD3+ lymphoid cells, whereas myeloid sarcoma is MPO/CD33/CD117-positive, a pitfall because blastic myeloid sarcoma can mimic lymphoma on H&E.
Plasmacytoma often arises in the vertebral body with bone destruction and shows CD138+ light-chain-restricted plasma cells on biopsy.
These are cytokeratin-positive or show lineage-specific markers and lack myeloid antigens and PML::RARA.
Hematoma shows blood-product signal evolution without solid enhancement, whereas myeloid sarcoma is an enhancing solid mass.

64035.recognize_zh: 普魯士藍鐵染色（Perls stain）中，箭頭所指的紅血球母細胞在核周圍排列著藍色鐵顆粒，即環形鐵粒母細胞（ringed sideroblast）；背景同時可見大量藍色鐵沉積；但此張對焦與解析度有限，環狀排列不甚清楚。
features: Erythroblast (arrow) with blue siderotic granules arranged around the nucleus, consistent with a ringed sideroblast
Abundant coarse blue iron deposits within particles/macrophages, indicating increased storage iron
Erythroid nuclei counterstained pink with neutral red/nuclear fast red
Other erythroblasts in the field with scattered perinuclear granules
Limited focus and thick particle areas reduce precision of granule counting
64035.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Perls Prussian blue (high power) shows increased storage iron, with abundant coarse blue deposits in the particle and macrophages. An erythroblast (arrow) shows blue siderotic granules distributed around the nucleus, consistent with a ringed sideroblast, and other erythroblasts contain perinuclear granules. The focus and thickness of the preparation limit precise counting of granules per cell (ICSH: >=5 granules encircling at least one third of the nucleus). In the setting of MDS, findings support ringed sideroblasts; quantification (>=15%, or >=5% with SF3B1 mutation) is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain a few (1-4) small granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than >=5 granules encircling the nucleus.
Congenital forms present young, with microcytic hypochromic red cells and no dysplasia or clonal cytogenetic/SF3B1 changes.

ddx.dx: Acquired non-clonal ringed sideroblasts (alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc toxicity, isoniazid, linezolid)
ddx.vs: Reversible causes lack SF3B1 mutation and clonal abnormalities and resolve after removing the cause, so history and copper levels are essential.
Artifactual precipitate lies on top of cells in multiple focal planes and is also present in cell-free background, unlike intracellular perinuclear granules.

63907.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片細胞極多，大部分是中至大型、核染色質細緻、有核仁、細胞質量中等偏藍的母細胞（箭頭），正常成熟顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞明顯被取代，符合急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Markedly cellular aspirate dominated by medium-to-large blasts
Blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and one or more nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale-to-moderately basophilic cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules
Residual maturing neutrophils, eosinophil precursors and scattered orthochromatic normoblasts
No Auer rods clearly resolved at this magnification
63907.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power is markedly cellular and shows a predominance of medium-to-large blasts with finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some containing fine granules (arrow). Residual granulocytic maturation, eosinophil precursors and scattered erythroid precursors are present but reduced. Auer rods cannot be confidently assessed at this magnification. A blast count on a 500-cell differential, cytochemistry/flow cytometry and genetic studies are needed for classification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are typically smaller with scant agranular cytoplasm and are MPO-negative/TdT-positive, whereas these blasts have more cytoplasm and some granules.
BPDCN blasts often show gray-blue agranular cytoplasm with peripheral vacuoles and pseudopods and are CD4/CD56/CD123/TCL1-positive and MPO-negative.
MDS has fewer than 20% blasts with prominent multilineage dysplasia, rather than sheets of blasts replacing the marrow.
Recovery marrow shows a synchronous wave of promyelocytes and myelocytes with orderly maturation, not a dominant population of agranular blasts.

63843.recognize_zh: 這張 HPLC 圖只見 HbA（Ao 83.9%）主峰，A2 視窗 3.59 分鐘的峰定量 5.8%（>3.5%），HbF 1.0%，沒有其他變異峰；HbA2 輕度升高但遠低於 HbE 帶因的 25–30%，符合 β 型地中海貧血帶因（β-thalassemia trait）。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC report with peak table and chromatogram
Dominant Ao (HbA) peak at 2.34 min, 83.9% of total area
Discrete A2-window peak at 3.59 min quantified at 5.8%
HbF 1.0%; small P2 and P3 peaks only
No variant peak in the D- or S-windows
63843.describe_en: Cation-exchange HPLC shows a predominant HbA peak with a discrete A2-window peak at 3.59 minutes quantified at 5.8%, and HbF of 1.0%. No abnormal variant peak is detected in the D- or S-windows. An HbA2 level in the 4-8% range without a structural variant is the characteristic pattern of beta-thalassemia heterozygosity; correlation with red cell indices (microcytosis, low MCH) and iron studies is advised. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia trait in the husband.

ddx.vs: HbE co-elutes in the A2 window but produces a much larger peak of about 25-30%, whereas beta-thalassemia trait gives an A2 of roughly 4-8%.

ddx.dx: Borderline HbA2 from other causes (e.g., HIV/zidovudine, hyperthyroidism, megaloblastic anemia)
ddx.vs: These give only mild HbA2 elevation without consistent microcytosis, whereas beta-thalassemia trait shows microcytic hypochromic indices with a normal or high red cell count.
Both cause microcytosis but have normal or low HbA2 (iron deficiency can lower HbA2 and mask beta-thalassemia trait).

63651.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片（a）與切片（b）中有兩群細胞：一群是大型、核質比高、核彼此擠壓（nuclear molding）而成簇的細胞，另一群是散在的小型成熟樣淋巴球；前者 CAM5.2 陽性（c），後者 CD20 陽性且流式為 kappa 限制（d）。
features: (a) Aspirate: cohesive clusters of large cells with high N:C ratio, nuclear molding, and inconspicuous nucleoli (black arrows)
(a) Separate small lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and condensed chromatin (green arrows)
(b) Biopsy H&E: diffuse sheets of molded large cells admixed with small dark lymphocytes
(c) CAM5.2: cytoplasmic keratin positivity in the large cell population
(d) CD20: positive small lymphoid cells in aggregates; inset flow plot shows kappa-restricted B cells
63651.describe_en: Multipanel composite of bone marrow aspirate, biopsy, immunohistochemistry, and flow cytometry. The aspirate (a) and core biopsy (b) show diffuse infiltration by two admixed populations: cohesive clusters of large cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, nuclear molding, and inconspicuous nucleoli, and small lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and condensed chromatin. The large cells are positive for CAM5.2 (c), while the small cells are CD20 positive (d) and kappa light chain restricted by flow cytometry (inset). Findings are consistent with concurrent bone marrow involvement by metastatic small cell carcinoma and a CD5-negative, CD10-negative mature B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Large B-cell or blastoid lymphoma alone
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are discohesive without nuclear molding and are keratin negative and CD20/CD45 positive.

ddx.dx: Other small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These are usually keratin negative and express CD99/NKX2.2, PHOX2B, or myogenin respectively, unlike TTF-1-positive small cell carcinoma.
Blasts are discohesive and express CD45, CD34, TdT, or myeloid markers but not keratin.
Merkel cell carcinoma shows perinuclear dot CK20 and is TTF-1 negative.

63651.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CAM5.2, CD20; flow

63587.recognize_zh: 多顆前骨髓球與骨髓球胞質內有成串的圓形透明小空泡，另可見雙核的紅血球母細胞（dyserythropoiesis），這種早期骨髓與紅系前驅細胞空泡化是 VEXAS 症候群的特徵性形態。
features: Multiple discrete, round, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in promyelocytes and myelocytes, often clustered at the cell periphery
Vacuolated precursors retain azurophilic/secondary granules and round to indented nuclei
Binucleated erythroid precursor with basophilic cytoplasm (bottom center), indicating dyserythropoiesis
Hypercellular aspirate with abundant granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation
Scattered orthochromatic normoblasts; blasts not increased in this field
63587.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a hypercellular specimen with abundant granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation. Numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes contain multiple small, sharply defined cytoplasmic vacuoles. A binucleated erythroid precursor is present, indicating dyserythropoiesis. Blasts are not increased in this field. In an older male with relapsing inflammatory disease and macrocytic anemia, vacuolization of myeloid and erythroid precursors is suggestive of VEXAS syndrome; UBA1 mutation analysis is recommended.

ddx.vs: Produces identical precursor vacuoles with ring sideroblasts and neutropenia, and is distinguished by low serum copper and absence of UBA1 mutation.
History of exposure and reversibility after withdrawal separate toxic vacuolization from VEXAS.
MDS diagnosis relies on significant dysplasia, blast count and clonal cytogenetic/molecular markers rather than precursor vacuoles, though MDS can coexist with VEXAS.
Storage vacuoles affect mature neutrophils and monocytes in aged EDTA samples rather than early precursors in fresh aspirates.

63523.recognize_zh: 血液抹片可見多顆標靶細胞與折疊狀紅血球，箭頭所指的紅血球血紅素濃縮成有稜角、一端或多端尖突的深染形狀（SC poikilocytes），而非典型細長鐮刀細胞，符合血紅素 SC 疾病。
features: Numerous target cells with central hemoglobin condensation
Dense, hyperchromic angular poikilocytes with one or more blunt pointed projections (SC poikilocytes, arrows)
Folded cells and cells with hemoglobin puddled to one side (irregular contracted cells)
Few if any classic elongated sickle cells
Normocytic red cells overall; scattered platelets, no nucleated red cells in this field
63523.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many target cells and folded red cells. Scattered dense, hyperchromic poikilocytes with angular outlines and blunt pointed projections are present (arrows), representing SC poikilocytes in which hemoglobin is condensed into an irregular shape. Classic elongated sickle cells and discrete intracellular HbC crystals are not conspicuous in this field. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin SC disease; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC showing approximately equal HbS and HbC is recommended.

ddx.vs: HbCC shows target cells, spherocytes, and rhomboid or hexagonal HbC crystals with parallel sides but lacks the pointed, sickle-like projections of SC poikilocytes.
HbSS shows many thin elongated sickle cells with tapered ends and fewer target cells, while HbSC shows abundant target cells with blunt angular SC forms.
HbS/β-thal shows microcytosis with classic sickle cells and target cells, and electrophoresis shows HbS with increased HbA2 rather than HbC.

ddx.dx: Liver disease or post-splenectomy target cells
ddx.vs: Acquired target cells are not accompanied by dense angular SC poikilocytes and hemoglobin analysis is normal.

63075.recognize_zh: CD15 染色中，只有少數散在的小型不規則細胞（顆粒球）呈棕色陽性，作為內部陽性對照；中央幾顆核大而淡、核仁明顯的大型細胞則完全不染；大細胞 CD15 陰性符合 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞，可與 CD15+ 的典型 RS 細胞區分。
features: Immunohistochemical stain for CD15 at high power
Scattered small cells with strong granular membranous/cytoplasmic CD15 staining (granulocytes, internal positive control)
Several large cells with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli (e.g., center and left) are CD15-negative
Background small lymphocytes are negative
No membranous or Golgi CD15 staining in large atypical cells
63075.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD15 shows staining limited to scattered small granulocytes, which serve as an internal positive control. The large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli are negative, as are the background small lymphocytes. The absence of CD15 in the large cells argues against Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells of classic Hodgkin lymphoma and supports LP cells. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD15-positive in most cases with membranous and paranuclear dot staining, together with CD30 positivity, whereas the large cells here are CD15-negative.
Can mimic NLPHL architecturally, but the HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and lack strong CD20/OCT2/BOB1.
Large cells are likewise CD15-negative, so diffuse architecture and lack of small B-cell nodules are required to distinguish it.

63267.recognize_zh: 低倍血液抹片中白血球數目明顯增加，許多有深藍色細胞質的中大型細胞散布其中，箭頭分別指出一顆芽細胞（較大、細胞質藍、邊緣不規則）與一顆較小圓形的淋巴球；新生兒血液中大量循環芽細胞是 TAM 的表現。
features: Low-power peripheral blood smear with increased nucleated cells
Numerous medium to large cells with basophilic cytoplasm and irregular outlines, consistent with circulating blasts
Arrow (center): larger blast with blue cytoplasm and irregular, possibly blebbed borders
Arrow (right): smaller round lymphocyte for comparison
Background red cells densely packed; nuclear and nucleolar detail not resolvable at this magnification
63267.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows leukocytosis with numerous circulating medium-sized to large mononuclear cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and irregular contours, interpreted as blasts, admixed with smaller lymphocytes (arrows indicate a blast and a lymphocyte). Cytologic detail such as chromatin pattern, nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs cannot be evaluated at this power, and higher magnification is required for blast enumeration. In a neonate with Down syndrome, the findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Blasts look similar; it is distinguished by onset after the neonatal period, persistence, and marrow involvement with fibrosis rather than spontaneous regression.
Shows a left-shifted neutrophilic series with myelocytes and toxic changes rather than a population of basophilic blasts.
May look identical at low power but lacks trisomy 21/GATA1 mutation, often has KMT2A rearrangement, and does not regress spontaneously.

63203.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中央一顆巨大巨噬細胞，細胞核小而圓，胞質極豐富、塞滿大小相近的細小透明空泡，呈泡沫（肥皂泡）狀，體積遠大於周圍的髓系與紅系前驅細胞；這是 Niemann-Pick 泡沫細胞的樣子。
features: Very large macrophage, many times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells
Small round nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm packed with small, uniform clear vacuoles giving a foamy, soap-bubble appearance
No fibrillary striations and no conspicuous sea-blue granules in this cell
Surrounding erythroid precursors, granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes; background fat droplets
63203.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a very large macrophage with a small round nucleus and abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous small, uniform, clear vacuoles, producing a foamy, soap-bubble appearance. Fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' texture and blue-green ceroid granules are not evident in this cell. The surrounding marrow contains erythroid and granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with a foamy storage macrophage (Niemann-Pick cell); acid sphingomyelinase activity or NPC1/NPC2 testing is needed to confirm the specific disorder.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated, fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than uniform round vacuoles.
Cytoplasm contains blue-green ceroid granules on Romanowsky stain rather than predominantly clear vacuoles.
Contains engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells rather than uniform empty vacuoles.
Seen in high cell turnover or lipid infusion with normal lysosomal enzyme activity; morphology alone may not separate them.

63139.recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示背部與肩部幾乎全面的鮮紅色紅皮症（erythroderma），伴隨細小脫屑與散在丘疹，符合 Sézary 症候群的皮膚表現。
features: Clinical photograph of the upper back and shoulders
Diffuse, confluent erythema involving nearly the entire visible skin surface
Fine scaling with scattered small papules/excoriations
No discrete tumors or ulcerated plaques visible
63139.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the upper back shows diffuse, confluent bright-red erythema involving nearly the entire visible skin surface, with fine scaling and scattered small papules. No discrete tumors or ulcerations are evident. Generalized erythroderma (≥80% body surface area) is a defining clinical feature of Sézary syndrome, but it is not specific and must be correlated with blood flow cytometry, TCR clonality, and skin biopsy.

ddx.vs: Psoriasis shows prior plaque psoriasis history and skin biopsy with psoriasiform hyperplasia and no clonal CD4+CD7−/CD26− circulating population.
Benign erythroderma lacks Sézary cell counts ≥1000/µL and a dominant T-cell clone; drug history and eosinophilia favor DRESS.
Erythrodermic MF has a history of preceding patch/plaque lesions and does not meet blood (B2) criteria for Sézary syndrome.
PRP shows salmon-orange erythema with islands of sparing and follicular keratotic papules.

62947.recognize_zh: CD3 染色下大量小至中型 T 細胞呈強棕色膜/質陽性，密集填滿結節，而夾雜其中的組織球與較大細胞為藍色陰性；豐富的 T 細胞背景是 T 細胞/組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的特徵，但也容易被誤判為 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous small-to-medium CD3-positive T cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining
T cells densely populate the aggregate and extend into the surrounding tissue
Interspersed CD3-negative cells with larger oval vesicular nuclei (histiocytes and occasional large atypical cells)
Slightly irregular T-cell nuclear contours without obvious large atypical T cells
62947.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 highlights numerous small-to-medium T cells densely populating the lymphohistiocytic aggregate and extending into the adjacent marrow. Interspersed CD3-negative cells with larger oval vesicular nuclei correspond to histiocytes and the scattered large atypical cells. The abundant T-cell background raises the possibility of a T-cell lymphoma; however, the T cells lack obvious cytologic atypia here, and the large atypical cells are B cells (CD20+/OCT2+), consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL shows atypical CD3+ T cells with antigen loss (CD5, CD7) and clonal TCR rearrangement rather than bland T cells surrounding rare large B cells.
AITL T cells co-express TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) with expanded CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks and EBV+ B blasts.
Reactive aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, and lack atypical large CD20+ B cells.

62883.recognize_zh: MIB-1（Ki-67）染色下，固有層內密集的淋巴球絕大多數為陰性，只有零星核陽性細胞，而腺窩基部上皮作為內部陽性對照；低增生指數是惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病的重要線索。
features: Dense lamina propria lymphoid infiltrate almost entirely negative for Ki-67
Only scattered nuclear-positive lymphocytes (low proliferation index, well under 10%)
Crypt epithelium shows strong nuclear positivity, serving as internal positive control
No clusters of proliferating large cells
62883.describe_en: MIB-1 (Ki-67) immunostain of colonic mucosa shows a dense lamina propria lymphoid infiltrate in which only scattered lymphocytes show nuclear staining, indicating a low proliferation index. The crypt epithelium stains strongly and serves as a valid internal control. No foci of increased proliferation are seen. A low Ki-67 index in a clonal CD8-positive T-cell infiltrate supports indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract rather than an aggressive T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MEITL typically shows a high Ki-67 index (often >50%), in contrast to the sparse staining here.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS involving gut
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS shows larger atypical cells with a moderate to high proliferation fraction, rather than a bland infiltrate with few Ki-67-positive cells.
Reactive infiltrates may also have low Ki-67 but are polyclonal with a mixed CD4/CD8 and B/plasma cell composition.

62819.recognize_zh: 骨髓核心切片中倍 H&E 下，骨小樑之間的骨髓幾乎被單一形態、胞質粉紅豐富、核偏位的漿細胞樣細胞瀰漫取代，其間有大量出血與少數脂肪空泡，正常三系造血細胞幾乎看不到，是瀰漫性骨髓置換（marrow replacement）的表現。
features: Moderate-power H&E core with diffuse replacement of intertrabecular marrow by a monomorphic infiltrate
Medium-sized discohesive cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate eosinophilic-to-pale cytoplasm (plasmacytoid)
Some cells with cytoplasmic clearing or halos
Abundant extravasated red cells interspersed among tumor cells
Scattered small fat vacuoles; bony trabeculae at right edge; residual hematopoiesis scant, with no megakaryocytes evident
62819.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows near-complete replacement of the intertrabecular space by a diffuse, monomorphic infiltrate of discohesive plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and moderate eosinophilic to pale cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic clearing. Extensive interstitial hemorrhage and scattered small fat vacuoles are present, and residual trilineage hematopoiesis is scant, with no megakaryocytes evident in this field. The infiltrate lacks gland formation or desmoplastic stroma. Although the appearance suggests a plasma cell neoplasm, immunohistochemistry is required, and in this case supported diffuse marrow involvement by metastatic lobular breast carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with diffuse involvement
ddx.vs: Myeloma shows CD138/MUM1-positive, light chain-restricted cells with clock-face chromatin, whereas this infiltrate is light chain negative and keratin/GATA3/ER positive.
Characteristically infiltrates marrow as single discohesive cells without desmoplasia or glands, mimicking plasma cells or histiocytes.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or plasmablastic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have less cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli and express CD45 and B-cell or plasmablastic markers rather than epithelial markers.
Mast cell infiltrates are often spindled, paratrabecular or perivascular with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are CD117/tryptase positive.

62755.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度極高、以成熟中的顆粒球為主並有網狀纖維明顯增生，免疫染色未見母細胞增加；下排的追蹤切片細胞密度下降、脂肪重新出現、纖維減少，符合腫瘤異位分泌 G-CSF 造成的反應性嗜中性類白血病反應與纖維化。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete loss of fat, dominated by maturing granulocytic cells (H&E, panel A)
Diffuse dense reticulin fibrosis with streaming fibers (panel B)
Immunostains (unlabeled) show myeloid-predominant infiltrate without clusters of positive blasts
Megakaryocytes present without prominent clustering or marked atypia in the fields shown
Lower row (presumably follow-up): reduced cellularity with return of adipocytes and less fibrosis
62755.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (upper row) shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-total replacement of fat by maturing granulocytic elements, accompanied by diffuse dense reticulin fibrosis. The immunostains shown, whose specific antibodies are not labeled in the image, do not demonstrate increased blast clusters. The lower row, presumably a subsequent biopsy, shows lower cellularity with reappearance of adipocytes and a less dense reticulin network. In the appropriate clinical context of a G-CSF-secreting tumor, findings are consistent with a neutrophilic leukemoid reaction with reactive marrow fibrosis that regressed after removal of the stimulus.

ddx.vs: CNL shows similar granulocytic hyperplasia but carries CSF3R mutations and persists without an identifiable G-CSF-producing tumor or regression after its removal.
CML shows basophilia, a myelocyte peak, small hypolobated megakaryocytes, and BCR::ABL1, which a leukemoid reaction lacks.
PMF has clustered atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes, JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations, and does not regress when an extramedullary tumor is resected.
Metastatic tumor would show keratin-positive cohesive epithelial nests within the fibrotic marrow.

62691.recognize_zh: 中央一顆淋巴球大小的細胞，淡藍色細胞質內有少量細小嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），但細胞核呈多葉/花瓣狀；有顆粒的淋巴球符合 NK 細胞，但核型不典型，需靠流式確認 NK 表型。
features: Single mononuclear cell slightly larger than neighboring RBCs
Nucleus deeply indented and multilobated (flower-like/cloverleaf contour) with condensed chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing a few fine azurophilic granules
No visible nucleoli
Background: rouleaux-like stacking, scattered ovalocytes and elongated RBCs, small platelets
62691.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single lymphoid cell with moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing a few fine azurophilic granules. The nucleus is atypical, with a deeply indented, multilobated flower-like contour and condensed chromatin without nucleoli. The red cells show rouleaux-like stacking and scattered ovalocytes; platelets are present. The granular cytoplasm supports a large granular lymphocyte, which fits chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells, but the lobated nucleus is not the typical round LGL morphology and a single cell cannot establish clonality or NK lineage. Findings are partially consistent with an NK-cell LGL; flow cytometry is required.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; T-LGL is surface CD3+, CD8+, CD57+ with clonal TRG/TRB rearrangement, whereas CLPD-NK is surface CD3 negative, CD16/CD56 positive.
ATLL flower cells have basophilic agranular cytoplasm with CD4+CD25+ phenotype and HTLV-1 serology, unlike this granular cytoplasm.
ANKL cells are larger with immature chromatin, visible nucleoli and a fulminant EBV-positive course, not the mature chromatin seen here.
Reactive LGLs are morphologically indistinguishable and are separated by transient course and polyclonal KIR expression.

62627.recognize_zh: Kappa 免疫染色中，大片腫瘤細胞群幾乎全為藍色核、不著色，僅一兩個細胞弱陽性；周圍蛋白質性積液強烈背景著色。腫瘤不表現 kappa，與 lambda 同樣陰性，符合 PEL 缺乏免疫球蛋白。
features: Large aggregate of round intermediate-to-large tumor cells in effusion cell block
Tumor cells negative for kappa, with only rare isolated positive cell (likely reactive plasma cell)
Strong background staining of surrounding proteinaceous fluid (serum immunoglobulin)
Faint cytoplasmic blush attributable to background diffusion rather than true expression
62627.describe_en: Kappa light chain immunohistochemistry on an effusion cell block shows a large aggregate of neoplastic cells that are negative, with only a rare isolated positive cell and intense background staining of the proteinaceous fluid. Combined with the negative lambda stain, the tumor lacks detectable immunoglobulin light chain expression. Light-chain negativity in a CD20-negative, MUM1-positive, HHV8-positive large-cell effusion lymphoma is consistent with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows strong monotypic cytoplasmic light chain, whereas these cells are negative for both kappa and lambda.
HHV8+ DLBCL usually expresses IgM lambda, whereas this tumor is light-chain negative.
Carcinoma is also Ig-negative but is keratin-positive and CD45/MUM1/LANA-negative.

62563.recognize_zh: 左圖低倍可見嗜酸性骨小樑之間被瀰漫性腫瘤細胞填滿；右圖高倍為大型多形細胞，胞質豐富淡嗜酸性、核呈不規則或腎形、染色質空泡狀並有小核仁，符合 ALCL 浸潤骨骼／軟組織。
features: Large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and irregular, focally kidney-shaped nuclei
Vesicular chromatin with small but distinct nucleoli; scattered hyperchromatic bizarre nuclei
Diffuse sheet-like infiltrate surrounding eosinophilic bone trabeculae at low power
Background with small clear vacuoles and scattered small lymphocytes; no necrosis in the fields shown
62563.describe_en: Two-panel H&E image. At low power, the tissue is diffusely replaced by a hypercellular infiltrate surrounding irregular eosinophilic bony trabeculae, without residual normal marrow elements appreciable in this field. At high power, the infiltrate consists of large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, irregular to kidney-shaped nuclei, vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli, admixed with occasional small lymphocytes and a finely vacuolated background. Findings are consistent with involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma in the context of the known ALK-positive case; immunohistochemistry for CD30 and ALK is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with keratin positivity, whereas ALCL cells are keratin-negative and diffusely CD30/ALK-positive.
CHL shows scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory and fibrotic background rather than sheets of large anaplastic cells.
Histiocytic sarcoma expresses CD163/CD68 and lacks CD30/ALK and hallmark cells.
Sarcoma lacks lymphoid markers and CD30/ALK positivity despite similar pleomorphism.

62499.recognize_zh: CD5 染色中，片狀小型淋巴球幾乎全部呈膜狀陽性，但強度中等；箭頭指的少數細胞呈較強、較清楚的環狀膜染色（推測為 T 細胞）。瀰漫浸潤的 B 細胞表現 CD5（強度弱於 T 細胞），符合 CLL。
features: Diffuse sheets of small round lymphoid cells with membranous CD5 staining
Moderate, relatively uniform staining intensity in the infiltrating cells
Scattered cells with crisper, stronger ring-like membranous staining (arrows), likely T cells
Scant interstitial spaces with CD5-negative stromal cells
62499.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 shows diffuse membranous positivity in sheets of small lymphoid cells. The staining intensity in the infiltrating cells is moderate, whereas scattered cells (arrows) show stronger, well-defined ring-like membranous staining consistent with background T cells. Because T cells are normally CD5-positive, coexpression with PAX5 or CD20 on the same population is required to confirm aberrant CD5 expression by B cells. Findings are consistent with a CD5-positive small B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, compatible with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5-positive but is CD23-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
A T-cell process would be CD3-positive and PAX5/CD20-negative, which distinguishes it from CD5-positive B cells.
Rare CD5-positive MZL is LEF1-negative and CD23-negative, with marginal zone or monocytoid morphology.

62435.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現大量母細胞，許多具深藍色無顆粒細胞質並有細胞質泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），旁邊有大團淡藍顆粒狀的巨大血小板與巨核細胞碎片，背景仍可見各階段顆粒球——在 CML 病史下符合巨核母細胞急變（megakaryoblastic blast crisis）。
features: Numerous blasts of variable size with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Several blasts show cytoplasmic blebs or budding, a clue to megakaryoblastic differentiation
Giant platelets and pale-blue granular megakaryocyte fragments/platelet clumps
Background left-shifted granulocytes (myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils) and a probable basophil
Red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and scattered target cells
62435.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in blasts of variable size with fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm, several of which display cytoplasmic blebs. Numerous giant platelets and pale granular megakaryocytic fragments are present. Left-shifted maturing granulocytes, including myelocytes and a probable basophil, persist in the background, and red cells show rouleaux-like stacking with scattered target cells. In a patient with known chronic myeloid leukemia, findings are consistent with megakaryoblastic blast phase; confirmation requires immunophenotyping for CD41/CD61/CD42b and demonstration of BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may contain granules or Auer rods and are MPO-positive, whereas megakaryoblasts are MPO-negative with blebs and CD41/CD61 expression.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without blebs and express TdT, CD19/CD10 and no platelet glycoproteins.
Morphology is similar, but a prior chronic phase, basophilia/left-shifted granulocytes and BCR::ABL1 establish blast phase of CML.
PMF shows leukoerythroblastosis and teardrop cells with far fewer blasts and is BCR::ABL1-negative.

62371.recognize_zh: 這是間期細胞核的螢光原位雜交（FISH）影像，DAPI 藍色核內可見紅、綠、藍三色訊號，其中一個紅色訊號遠離其他訊號、單獨存在，呈現分離（split）型態，符合 3q26 MECOM 區域重組。
features: Interphase nucleus counterstained with DAPI, hybridized with a three-color probe set (red, green, aqua/blue signals)
One red signal isolated at the periphery of the nucleus, separated from the other signals
A second red signal closely juxtaposed to a green signal (intact/colocalized pattern)
Additional small green signals and two blue signals clustered nearby
Single-nucleus image: probe identity and cutoff are not labeled, so interpretation relies on the case context
62371.describe_en: Interphase FISH image shows a single DAPI-counterstained nucleus hybridized with a multicolor probe set. One red signal is widely separated from its partner green signal, while the remaining red signal lies adjacent to a green signal, producing an abnormal split pattern. In the context of this case, the pattern is interpreted as rearrangement of the 3q26 (MECOM) region, consistent with inv(3)(q21q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2). Probe design and the scored percentage of abnormal nuclei are not provided in the image and should be reported from the laboratory study.

ddx.vs: Break-apart MECOM probes detect all 3q26 rearrangements; identifying the partner (3q21/GATA2 for inv(3)/t(3;3)) needs karyotype or dual-fusion probes.

ddx.dx: Normal nucleus with signal splitting artifact
ddx.vs: Artifactual splits are small and occur in a low percentage of nuclei below the laboratory cutoff, whereas true rearrangement shows wide separation in a clonal proportion of cells.

62307.recognize_zh: 一團細胞中可見數個細胞質豐富的大型細胞，內含粉紅色細長棒狀結晶（類 Auer 小體），其中一個細胞質內有粗大紅色結晶束，旁邊夾雜漿細胞，符合漿細胞腫瘤伴結晶貯積組織球（crystal-storing histiocytosis）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Multiple slender pink rod-like crystalline inclusions within the cytoplasm of several cells
One cell with a prominent refractile pink crystalline aggregate in the cytoplasm
Nuclei round to indented with coarse, clumped chromatin; admixed plasma cells
Some cells ruptured with dispersed granular cytoplasm at the cluster edge
62307.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and round to indented nuclei, several of which contain slender pink, needle-shaped Auer-rod-like crystalline inclusions and, in one cell, a larger refractile crystal aggregate. Admixed plasma cells with coarse chromatin are present, and some cells at the edge are disrupted with released granular cytoplasm. Precise distinction between crystal-laden histiocytes and plasma cells is limited on this Romanowsky-stained smear. Findings are suggestive of crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a plasma cell neoplasm; CD68/CD163 and CD138 immunostains with kappa/lambda studies would clarify cell lineage and light-chain type.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Auer rods occur in blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO positive, whereas these crystals lie in large histiocytic cells with abundant cytoplasm.
Gaucher-type cells show fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete refractile rod-shaped crystals.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal hexagonal crystals associated with eosinophils, not slender needle-like immunoglobulin crystals.
Crystal-containing plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with a hof and are CD138 positive, while histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive.

62243.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中有許多大型異常細胞，細胞質豐富、深藍並佈滿小空泡，核不規則、部分呈腎形或多核，與背景的小淋巴球及嗜中性球大小差異明顯，配合 CD30 陽性、ALK 陰性的免疫表型，符合 ALK 陰性退行性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）侵犯胸膜腔。
features: Numerous large, discohesive atypical cells several times the size of background lymphocytes
Moderate to low N:C ratio with irregular, reniform or multilobated nuclei, some binucleated
Finely granular chromatin with occasional visible nucleoli
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Loose aggregates of tumor cells without true epithelial cohesion or cell-in-cell molding
Background of small lymphocytes, neutrophils, eosinophil-like granulocytes and a single mesothelial cell
62243.describe_en: Diff-Quik stained pleural fluid cytology shows a cellular specimen with numerous large atypical cells, occurring singly and in loose aggregates, against a background of small lymphocytes, granulocytes and occasional mesothelial cells. The atypical cells have irregular, reniform to multilobated nuclei, occasional binucleation, fine chromatin and small nucleoli, with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous small vacuoles. No true cohesive epithelial clusters are identified. In conjunction with the reported CD3+, CD4+, CD30+, ALK-negative immunophenotype, findings are consistent with involvement by ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with molding and are keratin-positive and CD30/CD4-negative, whereas these cells are discohesive lymphoid cells.
Mesothelial cells have dense cytoplasm with a peripheral clear 'lacy' skirt, central round nuclei and windows between cells, and are calretinin/WT1 positive.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / primary effusion lymphoma
ddx.vs: Large B-cell lymphomas lack T-cell antigens (PEL is also HHV-8 LANA positive), which requires immunophenotyping rather than morphology to exclude.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and monotonous with round nuclei and lipid vacuoles, lacking the large pleomorphic horseshoe-shaped nuclei seen here.

62115.recognize_zh: G 顯帶核型標示 8 號與 14 號染色體各有一條衍生染色體（箭頭），核型式寫 46,XY,t(8;14)(q24.2;q32.3)；FISH 以 MYC（紅）/CEP8（藍）/IGH（綠）探針顯示兩個紅綠融合訊號，位於 der(8) 與 der(14)，確認 MYC::IGH 易位。
features: G-banded karyotype: 46,XY,t(8;14)(q24.2;q32.3) with arrows on der(8) and der(14)
Partial karyotype inset pairs normal 8 and 14 with their derivatives
Interphase FISH (MYC red, CEP8 aqua, IGH green): two red-green fusion signals plus one separate red and one green signal
Metaphase FISH localizes fusion signals to der(8) and der(14)
Otherwise normal chromosome complement
62115.describe_en: This composite is a non-morphologic cytogenetic figure. The G-banded karyotype shows 46,XY,t(8;14)(q24.2;q32.3), a balanced reciprocal translocation between the long arms of chromosomes 8 and 14 with no additional numerical or structural abnormalities evident. Tri-color dual-fusion FISH with MYC, CEP8, and IGH probes demonstrates two fusion signals in interphase, localized on metaphase to der(8) and der(14), with retained normal MYC and IGH signals on the non-rearranged homologs. Findings confirm an IGH::MYC rearrangement, characteristic of Burkitt lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context.

ddx.dx: Variant MYC translocations t(2;8) or t(8;22)
ddx.vs: These juxtapose MYC with IGK or IGL, so an IGH probe would show no fusion while a MYC break-apart probe would still be split.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Also carries MYC rearrangement, but requires an additional BCL2 (e.g., t(14;18)) break, so BCL2 FISH is needed to exclude it.
Involves IGH on 14q32 but the partner is 11q13 CCND1, not 8q24 MYC, and the der chromosomes differ.

62051.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色中低倍下，一個模糊結節區內陽性小淋巴球明顯較密集，其中散在許多由陽性細胞圍成、中心未染色的環狀結構（rosettes），與 NLPHL 中 T 細胞包圍 LP 細胞的型態相符。
features: Vague nodular zone with a higher density of positive small lymphocytes than the surrounding area
Numerous ring-shaped rosettes of positive cells surrounding larger unstained central cells
Membranous red staining of small lymphocytes, with negative small lymphocytes in the adjacent zones
Small vessels at the periphery of the nodule
Antibody identity not labeled; pattern typical of PD-1/CD57 or CD3 rosetting
62051.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at low-to-medium power shows a vaguely nodular area with an increased density of positive small lymphocytes. Many positive cells form ring-like rosettes around larger unstained central cells, while adjacent areas contain predominantly negative small lymphocytes. The rosetting pattern is characteristic of T cells (typically PD-1+ or CD57+ T follicular helper cells) encircling lymphocyte predominant cells. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation of the marker and of the B-cell phenotype of the central cells (CD20, OCT2, BOB1) is recommended.

ddx.vs: LRCHL may also show T-cell rosettes, but the central HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ and lack strong CD20/OCT2/BOB1.
PTGC nodules contain small B cells and scattered germinal center cells without LP cells rimmed by PD-1+ rosettes.
THRLBCL is diffuse with a CD8+ predominant T-cell background and usually lacks PD-1+ rosettes and nodular meshworks.

ddx.dx: Nodal peripheral T-cell lymphoma with TFH phenotype
ddx.vs: TFH lymphoma shows sheets of atypical PD-1+/CD10+/BCL6+ T cells with clonal TCR, not rosettes restricted around scattered large B cells.

61987.recognize_zh: 低倍可見緻密膠原構成的植入物包膜（capsule），其管腔側覆有一層纖維素性滲出物；放大後滲出物中散布大量異型細胞，高倍下為成群大型多形性細胞，核大不規則、染色質粗、可見分裂像；腫瘤細胞局限於包膜腔面的纖維素中，是乳房植入物相關 ALCL 的典型分布。
features: Low power: dense hyalinized fibrous implant capsule with a luminal layer of fibrinous exudate (labeled 'capsule')
Intermediate power: fibrin layer containing numerous scattered atypical cells along the luminal surface, sparing the capsule
High power: clusters of large pleomorphic cells with irregular, reniform or lobulated nuclei and coarse chromatin
Moderate amphophilic to clear cytoplasm; mitotic figures present
Tumor cells embedded in eosinophilic fibrinous and edematous stroma without invasion into the capsule in this field
61987.describe_en: Sections of the breast implant capsule show dense hyalinized fibrous tissue with a luminal layer of fibrinous exudate. At intermediate power, the fibrin layer contains numerous scattered atypical cells, which at high power are clusters of large pleomorphic cells with irregular to reniform nuclei, coarse chromatin, moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and mitotic figures, embedded in fibrinous material. The atypical cells are confined to the luminal fibrin without apparent capsular invasion in these fields. Findings are consistent with breast implant-associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pending confirmation by CD30 and ALK immunostains; the capsule should be fully sampled to assess for invasion or a mass-forming component.

ddx.dx: Reactive capsulitis with fibrin and histiocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive capsules show histiocytes, lymphocytes and occasional activated cells lacking the cohesive clusters of CD30-uniform large atypical cells with T-antigen loss.
This entity also resides in fibrin around implants or devices but consists of CD20+/PAX5+ EBV-positive large B cells rather than CD30+ ALK-negative T cells.
Carcinoma shows cohesive cytokeratin-positive and GATA3-positive nests that are negative for CD30 and T-cell markers.

61923.recognize_zh: 與H&E同一塊黏膜的免疫染色：固有層內大量浸潤細胞呈棕色陽性，密集包圍陰性（藍色）的腺窩，但腺窩上皮內幾乎沒有陽性細胞；圖題未註明抗體，只能確認浸潤細胞為強陽性、不具明顯上皮親和性，需對照CD56、CD3等染色判讀。
features: Immunohistochemical stain with strong brown positivity in a dense lamina propria infiltrate
Positive cells encircle and separate crypts, which are negative
Minimal intraepithelial positive cells, indicating no significant epitheliotropism
Crypt architecture preserved; positive cells less dense in the adjacent fragment at lower right
Specific antibody not indicated in the image or title
61923.describe_en: An immunohistochemical stain (antibody not specified) on colonic-type mucosa highlights a dense infiltrate of positive cells expanding the lamina propria and surrounding negative crypts. Intraepithelial positive cells are sparse, and crypt architecture is preserved. The specific marker cannot be determined from the image, so lineage cannot be assigned on this stain alone. When the infiltrate is CD56-positive with cytoplasmic CD3 and negative for CD5 and EBER, the findings support NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: ENKTL has the same NK phenotype but is EBER-positive with angiodestruction and necrosis, which are not seen in this non-destructive mucosal infiltrate.
MEITL shows heavy intraepithelial infiltration by CD8+ CD56+ T cells, whereas positive cells here spare the crypt epithelium.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Indolent T-LPD cells are CD56-negative T cells with surface CD3 and a clonal TCR rearrangement.

61731.recognize_zh: 骨髓 core 切片中倍可見脂肪空隙之間密集浸潤中型、染色質細緻、胞質淡的單調芽樣細胞，夾雜少數巨核細胞與紅系前驅細胞，細胞間有淡粉紅色間質；形態屬芽細胞浸潤，需 CD4/CD56/CD123 染色才能歸為 BPDCN。
features: Hypercellular marrow with dense interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate between adipocytes
Monotonous intermediate-sized cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Small nucleoli in some cells; scant to moderate pale cytoplasm
Scattered residual megakaryocytes and small dark erythroid precursors
Eosinophilic proteinaceous/fibrillar stromal material between cells
Subcortical bony trabecula at the top of the field
61731.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, medium power) shows a hypercellular marrow with a dense interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate between residual adipocytes. The infiltrate consists of monotonous intermediate-sized cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, with interspersed eosinophilic stromal material. Scattered residual megakaryocytes and erythroid precursors are present. Findings indicate marrow involvement by a blastic neoplasm, compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm when supported by CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, but AML is MPO, lysozyme, CD34 or CD117-positive and lacks coordinated CD123/TCF4/TCL1 with CD56.
Lymphoblasts have higher N:C ratio and are TdT-positive with PAX5/CD19 or CD3 expression.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma-like interstitial infiltrate of chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: CMML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with dysplastic megakaryocytes and increased monocytes rather than a monotonous blastic infiltrate.

61667.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中，在脂肪與造血細胞之間可見數個組織球，細胞質內塞滿許多約 2–4 μm、周圍帶透明暈的小圓形酵母菌（視野右上及中央最清楚），這種細胞內小型酵母是組織胞漿菌症（histoplasmosis）的線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow-type tissue with scattered adipocytes and mixed hematopoietic precursors, including erythroid cells and eosinophils
Scattered histiocytes with abundant pale granular to foamy cytoplasm
Clusters of tiny (about 2-4 um) round to oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms, each with a central basophilic dot and a clear surrounding halo, best seen at upper right and centre
No granulomas or necrosis evident in this field
Organisms are uniform in size without large or capsule-like forms
61667.describe_en: Section of bone marrow at intermediate power shows cellular marrow with adipocytes, erythroid and granulocytic precursors, and scattered eosinophils. Interspersed are histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm containing clusters of small, uniform, round to oval yeast forms measuring about 2-4 um, each with a basophilic centre and a clear halo. Well-formed granulomas and necrosis are not seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of disseminated histoplasmosis, to be confirmed with fungal stains (GMS, PAS), culture or antigen testing.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes are similar in size but contain a rod-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and do not stain with GMS or PAS, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are GMS positive and lack a kinetoplast.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by a central transverse septum and include elongated sausage-shaped forms, rather than budding as uniform oval yeasts.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable (4-10 um) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding, unlike these tiny uniform intracellular yeasts.
Toxoplasma bradyzoites are non-budding crescentic organisms within cysts and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular cup-shaped forms, both differing from intrahistiocytic budding yeasts.

61603.recognize_zh: 整片單調、互相黏合的中大型腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫性浸潤，右側有地圖狀壞死與出血；形態上是高度惡性的大細胞淋巴瘤，需靠 CD138/MUM1 陽性、CD20 陰性與 EBER 陽性才能確認為漿母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of monotonous medium-to-large cells
Round nuclei with vesicular chromatin; some cells with eccentric nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Delicate intervening capillaries and thin fibrous septa
Scattered clear spaces, possibly tingible-body macrophages
Large geographic zone of necrosis with hemorrhage on the right
61603.describe_en: H&E section at low-to-medium power shows effacement by a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of monotonous medium-to-large neoplastic cells with round nuclei, vesicular chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, some with eccentric nuclei. Delicate vessels traverse the tumor, and scattered clear spaces suggest tingible-body macrophages. A large geographic area of necrosis with hemorrhage is present on the right. Plasmacytoid detail is limited at this magnification; with the supporting CD138-positive, EBER-positive immunoprofile, findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Can look identical on H&E but expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks the CD138+/MUM1+ plasmacytic phenotype.
Shows a starry-sky pattern of medium-sized cells with squared-off cytoplasm, CD20+/CD10+/BCL6+, near-100% Ki-67 and MYC::IGH without plasmacytic markers.
Similar phenotype; favors myeloma if there is M-protein, marrow clonal plasma cells and EBV negativity.
Cohesive nests on H&E may mimic; keratin or S100/SOX10 positivity and lack of CD45/CD138/MUM1 separate them.
