61539.recognize_zh: 紅色箭頭指的巨大血小板呈淡紫色顆粒狀、大小約與紅血球相當，黃色箭頭指的是較小但仍大於一般血小板的大血小板；不要把巨大血小板當成紅血球或淋巴球而漏算。
features: Giant platelet (red arrow) roughly the size of a red cell with pale purple granular cytoplasm, adjacent to a small dense dark body
Large platelet (yellow arrow) clearly larger than surrounding normal platelets
Many small normal platelets and loose platelet aggregates scattered among red cells
Crowded red cells with mild crenation; no schistocytes or spherocytes evident
Strand of pink-purple amorphous material at left edge (likely smear/fibrin artifact)
61539.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild crenation and numerous normal-sized platelets with small aggregates. A giant platelet approaching the diameter of a red cell (red arrow) and a large platelet (yellow arrow) are identified. No leukocytes are present in this field. The findings illustrate platelet macrocytosis; because giant platelets may fall outside the analyzer platelet size gate, an automated count may be falsely low and should be verified on the smear.

ddx.dx: Nucleated red cell or small lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Both have a discrete dense nucleus, whereas a giant platelet is anucleate with a central granular zone.
Gray platelets are large but pale gray and agranular due to absent alpha granules, unlike these platelets with visible purple granules.

ddx.dx: Immune thrombocytopenia with young large platelets
ddx.vs: ITP shows occasional large platelets but with a genuinely low platelet count on smear, whereas this smear shows abundant platelets.

61475.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中，少數大型細胞呈細胞膜與細胞質棕色陽性，並在核旁出現濃縮的點狀高爾基體（Golgi）染色，部分為雙核／分葉核的 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞；周圍大量小淋巴球為陰性（藍色），符合典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤。
features: Scattered large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD30 staining
Distinct paranuclear dot-like (Golgi) accentuation of CD30 in several positive cells
Positive cells include binucleate/bilobed forms consistent with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells
Some positive cells show pericellular clearing, consistent with lacunar cells
Background small-to-medium lymphocytes and histiocytes are CD30 negative
61475.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry on a lymph node shows scattered large neoplastic cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining and conspicuous paranuclear dot-like Golgi accentuation. Several positive cells are binucleate or have bilobed nuclei, and some are surrounded by clear lacunar spaces. The background small lymphocytes and histiocytes are negative. Findings support Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells of classical Hodgkin lymphoma, to be interpreted with CD15 positivity, weak PAX5 and negative CD45/CD20 staining.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows uniform strong CD30 in cohesive sheets or sinusoids with T-cell markers or ALK positivity, rather than scattered HRS cells in a negative background.
Activated immunoblasts are CD30+ but are smaller, mononuclear, CD45/CD20 positive and CD15 negative.
LP (popcorn) cells are CD30 and CD15 negative and strongly CD20/OCT2/BOB1 positive.
PMBL CD30 is weak and heterogeneous in sheets of CD20-positive large B cells with sclerosis, lacking the Golgi-dot pattern in isolated HRS cells.

61411.recognize_zh: CD21 染色（100x）在大型腫瘤細胞片中呈現稀疏、斷裂且不規則的濾泡樹突細胞（FDC）網狀結構，腫瘤細胞本身陰性，提示腫瘤呈濾泡/結節性生長並破壞原有濾泡，符合 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤的背景結構。
features: CD21 highlights an irregular, loose and fragmented follicular dendritic cell meshwork with branching dendritic processes
Meshwork extends through sheets of tumor cells rather than forming compact, well-circumscribed follicles
Neoplastic large cells with round to oval nuclei are CD21-negative (hematoxylin counterstain only)
Pale intervening areas and a small vessel without meshwork
61411.describe_en: CD21 immunohistochemistry at 100x shows an irregular, expanded and disrupted follicular dendritic cell meshwork permeating sheets of large tumor cells, which are themselves negative. Well-formed, compact follicular dendritic networks of reactive follicles are not seen. The findings indicate a follicular/nodular growth pattern with effacement of normal follicles, supporting the architecture described in large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: FL shows CD21+ meshworks in back-to-back follicles of centrocytes/centroblasts that are typically BCL2-positive and MUM1-negative without IRF4 rearrangement.
DLBCL NOS generally lacks residual FDC meshworks, whereas IRF4-rearranged LBCL often retains a follicular pattern.
AITL shows expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks around high endothelial venules with atypical CD4+/PD1+/CD10+ T cells rather than sheets of B cells.

61347.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD8 免疫染色可見大量棕色陽性小淋巴球，散佈於間質並排成小群或線狀排列（部分似沿血竇分佈），在脂肪與其他造血細胞之間相當醒目，支持 CD8 陽性 T 細胞大顆粒淋巴球白血病（T-LGL）的浸潤。
features: Increased CD8-positive small lymphocytes with membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Interstitial distribution with small clusters and linear/cord-like arrays, some suggestive of intrasinusoidal location
Positive cells are small with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm; no large atypical cells
Interspersed CD8-negative hematopoietic cells and adipocytes in a normocellular to mildly hypocellular marrow
61347.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for CD8 shows an increased population of small CD8-positive T lymphocytes distributed interstitially, forming small aggregates and linear arrays that in part suggest intrasinusoidal infiltration. The positive cells are small without cytologic atypia, and background hematopoietic elements are CD8 negative. The pattern is subtle on H&E and highlighted by immunohistochemistry; in conjunction with a peripheral LGL expansion and a clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement, findings are consistent with involvement by T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive CD8+ T-cell expansion (viral infection, autoimmune disease, post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates lack a persistent clonal TCR rearrangement and usually lack STAT3 mutation or intrasinusoidal linear clusters of TIA-1/granzyme B-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell proliferations are surface CD3 negative, CD56 positive and lack TCR gene rearrangement.
Shows a prominent sinusoidal infiltrate of medium-sized, usually CD4-/CD8- gamma-delta T cells with isochromosome 7q and aggressive clinical course.
Cells are larger and atypical, EBV positive, CD3-/CD56+, with fulminant clinical presentation.

61155.recognize_zh: 腸黏膜固有層（lamina propria）被密集的 CD117 強陽性細胞填滿並擠在隱窩（crypt）之間，呈膜狀及胞質染色，腺體上皮為陰性；這是肥大細胞白血病或全身性肥大細胞增生症侵犯腸胃道的表現。
features: Dense sheets and cords of CD117-positive cells expanding the lamina propria between colonic-type crypts
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD117 staining in round to polygonal cells
Crypt epithelium with goblet cells is CD117-negative (internal negative control)
Crypts are separated and focally distorted but not destroyed
Lower left area of lamina propria with fewer positive cells, showing a mixed background
61155.describe_en: Section of large intestinal-type mucosa stained for CD117 shows the lamina propria diffusely expanded by a dense infiltrate that separates and surrounds the crypts. The infiltrating cells display strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD117 staining, forming cohesive sheets and cords, while the crypt epithelium is negative. The density and sheet-like arrangement exceed what is seen in reactive mucosal mast cell increases. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with gastrointestinal involvement by a mast cell neoplasm (mast cell leukemia/systemic mastocytosis); coexpression of CD25 and tryptase should be documented.

ddx.vs: GIST is a spindle or epithelioid mass centered in the muscularis propria with DOG1 positivity, not a lamina propria infiltrate of round tryptase-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive mucosal mastocytosis (e.g., IBS or colitis)
ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are evenly scattered single cells, typically <20-30/HPF, and lack clusters, sheets, and CD25 expression.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma or AML involving the bowel
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts may be CD117-positive but are also CD34/MPO-positive and tryptase-negative, with blast cytology.
The infiltrate is dominated by eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and eosinophilic granules, which are CD117-negative.

61091.recognize_zh: CT 冠狀與軸切面顯示脾臟被巨大、薄壁、內含均勻低密度液體並有細隔的囊性病灶撐大；組織學為囊壁內襯一層上皮，免疫染色時該內襯上皮呈陽性，提示上皮性（腺癌）來源而非單純脾囊腫。
features: Radiology (A): massive splenomegaly replaced by a large, thin-walled, fluid-attenuation cystic lesion with fine internal septa, displacing adjacent viscera
H&E (B, top): cyst wall lined by a single to focally stratified epithelial layer overlying fibrotic/hemorrhagic splenic tissue, with luminal debris
IHC (B, middle and bottom): strong staining confined to the epithelial lining (antibodies not labeled; pattern consistent with epithelial markers)
Cytologic atypia of the lining cannot be assessed at this resolution
61091.describe_en: Contrast CT shows marked splenic enlargement due to a large, thin-walled cystic lesion with fine septations. Histologic sections show a cyst wall lined by an epithelial layer overlying compressed splenic parenchyma, and immunostains highlight the lining epithelium. The antibodies are not labeled and cytologic atypia cannot be judged at the available resolution. In context, findings are consistent with a cystic splenic lesion lined by epithelium; correlation with keratin/CK7/CK20/CDX2/TTF-1 profile and exclusion of a mesothelial or true epithelial cyst is needed to support metastatic adenocarcinoma of unknown primary.

ddx.vs: Epidermoid cysts are lined by bland squamous or mesothelial-type epithelium without architectural complexity, atypia or mitoses, and are CK+/calretinin variable but not adenocarcinoma-type (e.g., CDX2/TTF-1).
Pseudocysts have a fibrous wall without any epithelial lining and would be keratin-negative.
Vascular cysts are lined by flattened endothelium that is CD31/D2-40 positive and keratin negative.
Echinococcal cysts show a laminated acellular membrane with germinal layer and protoscolices rather than an epithelial lining.

61027.recognize_zh: 視野中央的淋巴球細胞質量中等、淡藍色，內含許多細小的嗜天青紫紅色顆粒，核圓略偏位、染色質成塊，是典型大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）的樣子。
features: Single lymphocyte slightly larger than a small lymphocyte, with moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Numerous fine azurophilic granules distributed throughout the cytoplasm
Round, slightly eccentric nucleus with coarsely clumped mature chromatin and no nucleolus
Background red cells with mild ovalocytosis; scattered normal platelets
No other leukocytes in the field
61027.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large granular lymphocyte with moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm containing numerous fine azurophilic granules and a round, slightly eccentric nucleus with mature clumped chromatin. Background red cells show mild ovalocytosis, and platelets appear adequate in this field. The cell is a morphologically normal large granular lymphocyte (cytotoxic T or NK cell); if LGLs are persistently increased with cytopenias, flow cytometry and T-cell receptor clonality studies are indicated to evaluate for LGL leukemia.

ddx.dx: T-LGL leukemia / chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: Cannot be separated by single-cell morphology; requires a sustained LGL lymphocytosis with an immunophenotypically abnormal, clonal population.
Myeloid precursors are larger with more abundant cytoplasm, coarser primary granules or pink secondary granules, and finer chromatin, sometimes with a Golgi zone.
Basophils have large, dark purple-black granules that obscure the nucleus rather than fine sparse azurophilic granules.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant, basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and generally lack discrete azurophilic granules.

60899.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片左側一小團細胞核深染、互相擠壓變形的細胞（crush artifact）位於疏鬆纖維黏液樣基質中，與右側含脂肪、三系造血的正常骨髓明顯不同；高核質比的小圓藍細胞易被擠壓，在尤文氏肉瘤分期時應提高警覺並做 CD99 染色。
features: Focus at left of crushed, hyperchromatic cells with high N:C ratio and smeared nuclear chromatin
Crushed cells lie within loose edematous/fibromyxoid stroma, distinct from surrounding marrow
Adjacent marrow at right is normocellular with fat spaces and trilineage hematopoiesis including megakaryocytes
Bone trabeculae at left and right edges; no well-preserved tumor morphology
60899.describe_en: Low-power view of the staging bone marrow core biopsy shows a discrete focus at the left composed of crushed, hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio set in a loose, edematous stroma, sharply distinct from the adjacent normocellular marrow with maturing trilineage hematopoiesis. The crush artifact precludes detailed cytologic assessment. In the context of Ewing sarcoma staging, the focus is suspicious for metastatic tumor, and immunohistochemistry (CD99, NKX2.2) is required for confirmation; CD99 confirmed involvement in this case.

ddx.dx: Crushed normal lymphoid aggregate or hematogones
ddx.vs: Benign lymphoid aggregates are circumscribed, lack stromal desmoplasia and stain for CD3/CD20 rather than CD99/NKX2.2.
Neuroblastoma also yields crushed small round blue cells but shows neuropil/rosettes and is PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive and CD99 negative.
Lymphoblasts are CD99 positive like Ewing sarcoma but express TdT and CD45.
Rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin and myogenin positive.

60835.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有體積巨大的巨噬細胞，胞質充滿大小一致的透明泡沫狀空泡（foamy/bubbly cytoplasm），胞核小而偏位，部分細胞含少量藍色內容物，符合 Niemann-Pick C 型的泡沫細胞（foam cells）。
features: Very large macrophages (many times the size of surrounding marrow cells) with abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm packed with small, uniform, clear to pale lavender vacuoles giving a foamy, honeycomb/soap-bubble appearance
Small round to irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin, one to two per cell, eccentric or central
Some cells with faint bluish granular/linear material among the vacuoles (panel D) and phagocytosed cells
Background of normal-appearing hematopoietic precursors
60835.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show scattered large storage macrophages among otherwise unremarkable hematopoietic cells. The macrophages have abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous small, uniform, clear vacuoles producing a foamy appearance, with small, occasionally binucleate nuclei; some contain faint bluish granular material or engulfed cells. Classic Gaucher-type wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm is not seen. Findings are consistent with foam cells of a lipid storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease type C; filipin staining, oxysterol/lysosphingolipid biomarkers and NPC1/NPC2 genetic testing are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete clear vacuoles, and show reduced glucocerebrosidase activity.

ddx.dx: Niemann-Pick disease type A/B (acid sphingomyelinase deficiency)
ddx.vs: ASMD foam cells look similar morphologically and are separated by low acid sphingomyelinase activity/SMPD1 mutation, whereas NPC has normal enzyme activity with NPC1/NPC2 mutation.

ddx.dx: Sea-blue histiocytes/pseudo-storage cells (e.g., ITP, CML, hyperlipidemia)
ddx.vs: Secondary lipid-laden or sea-blue histiocytes occur in high-turnover states and contain blue-green ceroid granules on Giemsa, with the underlying disease evident clinically.

captions: A: large binucleate foam cell with finely vacuolated cytoplasm
B: foamy macrophage in a thin area of smear
C: foam cell with uniform clear vacuoles and phagocytosed cells
D: foam cell with irregular nucleus and bluish granular material among vacuoles
E: foamy storage cell with vacuolated cytoplasm at the edge of a cell cluster

60771.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片被片狀的非典型漿細胞取代（細胞質豐富、核偏位、核仁明顯），多顆細胞核內可見圓形淡嗜酸性、周圍有空暈的包涵體（Dutcher bodies），部分形成環狀外觀。
features: Sheets of large atypical plasma cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei, replacing normal marrow elements
Nuclear pleomorphism with vesicular chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli (anaplastic/plasmablastic features)
Multiple round, pale eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo (Dutcher bodies), some creating a ring-like nucleus
Occasional extracellular or intracytoplasmic eosinophilic globular material and scattered mitotic figures
Residual fat spaces; normal hematopoiesis largely absent in this field
60771.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows near-complete replacement by sheets of large atypical plasma cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli. Numerous plasma cells contain round, pale eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions with a surrounding clear halo, representing Dutcher bodies (cytoplasmic immunoglobulin invaginating into the nucleus). Mitotic figures are present and normal hematopoietic elements are scant. Findings are consistent with extensive involvement by plasma cell myeloma with anaplastic features and abundant Dutcher bodies.

ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies are also common, but the infiltrate is a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and mature plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than sheets of large anaplastic plasma cells.
Morphology and CD138+/CD20- phenotype overlap; favor myeloma when there is a serum/urine M-protein, CRAB features and no EBV (EBER) or HIV/immunodeficiency context.
Epithelial cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin positive, lacking CD138/MUM1 with light chain restriction.
Immunoblasts express CD20/PAX5, whereas myeloma cells are CD20/PAX5 negative with monotypic cytoplasmic light chain.

60579.recognize_zh: 十個嗜中性球（A–J）的分葉核因偶然的折疊與分葉形狀，分別像阿拉伯數字 0 到 9；細胞質有正常細小的淡紫色顆粒、染色質成熟，屬正常嗜中性球核形的變異，不代表病理。
features: Mature neutrophils with fine pink-lilac specific granules in abundant cytoplasm
Condensed, clumped mature chromatin in lobated or band-like nuclei
Nuclear contours folded or segmented into shapes resembling numerals 0 through 9 (panels A-J)
Normal number of lobes (mostly 2-4) without hypersegmentation, hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger forms
60579.describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood neutrophils shows mature cells with abundant cytoplasm containing fine specific granules and nuclei with condensed chromatin. The nuclear segments and bands are folded into configurations resembling the numerals 0 through 9. There is no hypersegmentation, hypogranulation, toxic change or bilobed pseudo-Pelger-Huet morphology. These are normal morphologic variants of neutrophil nuclear shape and carry no diagnostic significance.

ddx.vs: Pelger forms have bilobed spectacle-shaped or non-lobated nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin and often hypogranular cytoplasm, unlike these normally segmented, granulated cells.
Hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes or many five-lobed cells, whereas these nuclei have a normal number of segments.
Panel A resembles a ring, but true ring neutrophils have a continuous doughnut nucleus with a central hole in increased numbers.

60643.recognize_zh: 同一淋巴結切片中，左上方為深染、密集的小淋巴球區（CLL/SLL），右下方則為淡染、由大型細胞組成的區域；免疫染色中增殖指標只在大細胞區明顯升高，呈現 CLL 正在轉化為大細胞淋巴瘤（Richter 轉化）的交界。
features: Panel A (H&E, low power): sharp interface between a dark, densely cellular small lymphocytic area (upper left) and a paler area of large cells (lower right)
Inset: large cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with scattered apoptotic bodies
Panel B: a pan-lymphoid/B-cell immunostain (antigen not labeled) strongly positive in both compartments
Panel C: immunostain (antigen not labeled) diffusely positive in the small-cell area and more patchy/weaker in the large-cell area
Panel D: nuclear proliferation marker-like staining (antigen not labeled) low in the small-cell area and high in the large-cell area
60643.describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement by two juxtaposed components. The upper left contains a diffuse infiltrate of small round lymphocytes typical of small lymphocytic lymphoma, while the lower right consists of sheets of large cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and apoptotic debris. Immunostains show both components express the same broad lineage marker, a second marker is strong in the small-cell component and attenuated in the large-cell component, and nuclear staining consistent with a proliferation index is markedly higher in the large-cell area; the antigens are not labeled in the figure. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with Richter transformation to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, captured at the interface.

ddx.vs: Proliferation centers contain prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts with intermediate Ki-67 and are not broader than a 20x field, whereas true Richter shows confluent sheets of centroblast/immunoblast-sized cells.
Morphology is similar; clonal relatedness requires IGHV/IG rearrangement comparison, which has prognostic importance.
Hodgkin-type transformation shows scattered CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background, not sheets of large B cells.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive throughout, while the small-cell component here is CLL/SLL.

60707.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞過多、巨核細胞增生且成簇，網狀纖維染色顯示明顯纖維化；淋巴結可見萎縮退化的生發中心、血管玻璃樣變穿入濾泡，濾泡間區血管增生，符合 TAFRO 症候群（Castleman 病變異型）。
features: Panel A (BM, 100x): hypercellular marrow between trabeculae
Panel A (BM, 400x): megakaryocytic hyperplasia with clustered, hyperlobated megakaryocytes
Panel A (reticulin): increased reticulin fibers forming a dense network (marrow fibrosis)
Panel B (LN, 40x): preserved follicles with small regressed germinal centers and expanded interfollicular zones
Panel B (LN, 400x): atrophic hyalinized germinal center surrounded by concentric mantle zone lymphocytes (onion-skin pattern)
Panel B (LN, 400x): hypervascular interfollicular area with congested vessels and plasma cells/red cells
60707.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular with megakaryocytic hyperplasia, including clusters of hyperlobated megakaryocytes, and reticulin stain shows increased reticulin fibrosis. The lymph node shows preserved architecture with regressed, hyalinized germinal centers surrounded by concentrically arranged mantle zone lymphocytes, together with interfollicular hypervascularity. Findings are consistent with multicentric Castleman disease of hyaline-vascular/mixed type in a patient with the TAFRO clinical syndrome (thrombocytopenia, anasarca, fever, reticulin fibrosis, organomegaly).

ddx.vs: HHV8 MCD shows plasmablasts in mantle zones positive for LANA-1 and lambda, whereas TAFRO is HHV8 negative.
PMF shows atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation and leukoerythroblastosis, not associated with Castleman lymphadenopathy and anasarca.
AITL shows regressed follicles with expanded follicular dendritic meshworks and atypical TFH-phenotype T cells with clonal TCR, rather than onion-skin mantle zones.
SLE may show necrosis with hematoxylin bodies and serologic autoantibodies, which are absent in TAFRO.

60515.recognize_zh: 大型淋巴球有豐富淡藍灰色細胞質，細胞邊緣呈扇貝狀包繞相鄰紅血球，接觸紅血球處顏色較深藍，核圓而染色質中度濃縮，是典型的 Downey II 型反應性淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocyte, clearly larger than a resting lymphocyte
Low N:C ratio with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Scalloped cytoplasmic border wrapping around adjacent red cells with darker blue staining at points of contact
Round to slightly irregular eccentric nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin, no distinct nucleolus
Rare small azurophilic granule-like material; background normocytic red cells
60515.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with a low N:C ratio and abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm. The cytoplasmic margin is scalloped where it indents around adjacent red cells, with deeper basophilia at the points of contact. The nucleus is round to slightly irregular with moderately condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphocyte (Downey type II), typical of infectious mononucleosis and other viral infections.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have folded or kidney-shaped nuclei with lacy chromatin and cytoplasm containing fine granules and vacuoles, lacking the red-cell-hugging peripheral basophilia.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm but contain discrete coarse azurophilic granules and do not show basophilic scalloping around red cells.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with a pale ground-glass chromatin, and occur as a monotonous population.
Plasma cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei, a perinuclear hof and uniformly deep blue cytoplasm.

60451.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量明顯增加、脂肪細胞少，造血細胞以核深染、分葉或碎塊狀的成熟顆粒球為主，紅血球前驅細胞相對少（M:E 比上升）；在嗜中性球減少的病人，這種以成熟嗜中性球為主的高細胞性骨髓支持骨髓滯留症（myelokathexis）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with only a few adipocytes at the right edge
Increased M:E ratio: sheets of granulocytic cells, predominantly mature neutrophils with lobated dark nuclei
Right-shifted maturation, with many nuclei appearing as small separated dense fragments
Scattered erythroid precursors and occasional megakaryocytes; eosinophils present
Bony trabecula at upper left; no blast clusters, granulomas, or fibrosis at this power
60451.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, medium power) shows a hypercellular marrow with scant fat. The hematopoietic population is dominated by granulocytic cells with an increased M:E ratio and a right shift in maturation, featuring numerous mature neutrophils with lobated to fragmented dense nuclei. Erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes are present but relatively reduced, and there is no increase in blasts or abnormal infiltrate. In a patient with chronic neutropenia, warts and hypogammaglobulinemia, these findings are consistent with myelokathexis (WHIM syndrome).

ddx.vs: CML shows left-shifted myeloid hyperplasia with myelocyte peak, basophils and dwarf megakaryocytes with peripheral leukocytosis and BCR::ABL1, unlike right-shifted retained neutrophils with peripheral neutropenia.
Reactive hyperplasia is left-shifted with toxic changes and peripheral neutrophilia rather than accumulation of hypersegmented mature neutrophils.
CNL shows neutrophilic hyperplasia but with sustained peripheral neutrophilia and CSF3R mutation, not neutropenia.

60387.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下，小而深染的淋巴球之間可見大型細胞，具大核、明顯嗜酸性核仁，其中有雙核或多葉核的 Reed-Sternberg 樣細胞與帶周圍空暈的 lacunar 樣細胞，符合 SLL 背景中的 Hodgkin 細胞。
features: Large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli
Occasional binucleate/multilobated Reed-Sternberg-like cells
Lacunar-type cells with cytoplasmic retraction halos
Background of small round lymphocytes with dense chromatin
Admixed histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and scattered eosinophils
60387.describe_en: High-power view of lymph node shows numerous small, round lymphocytes with condensed chromatin, among which are scattered large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli. Some are binucleate or multilobated, resembling Reed-Sternberg cells, and others show lacunar-type retraction. Histiocytes and occasional eosinophils are admixed. Findings are suggestive of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells arising in a background of small lymphocytic lymphoma (Hodgkin-type Richter transformation), to be confirmed by CD30, CD15 and PAX5 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Paraimmunoblasts lack binucleation and lacunar halos and are CD20+/CD30-, whereas HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5.
Scattered HRS-like cells set directly in CLL cells without a reactive T-cell/histiocyte/eosinophil microenvironment are not diagnosed as classic Hodgkin lymphoma.
ALCL shows cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and uniform strong CD30 with T-cell markers or ALK, not scattered HRS cells in a B-cell background.

60195.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中白血球稀少，但出現的有核細胞多數是核質比高、細胞質少的母細胞，只見到少數嗜中性球與淋巴球，代表循環中母細胞比例高，符合由 MDS 進展而來的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Low-power field with few nucleated cells overall, suggestive of leukopenia
Most nucleated cells are blasts: medium-sized with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Only rare segmented neutrophils and lymphocytes
Platelets appear present but not abundant
Red cells largely normocytic; fine blast detail (nucleoli, Auer rods) not resolvable at this power
60195.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows relatively few nucleated cells, the majority of which are blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Only rare segmented neutrophils and lymphocytes are seen. Red cells are largely normocytic, and platelets are present in modest numbers. Nuclear detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In a patient with prior MDS with excess blasts, findings are consistent with progression to acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: MDS-EB-2 has 5–19% peripheral blasts, so a blast count of ≥20% (here 26%) is required to call AML.
Lymphoblasts may look similar at low power, and flow cytometry is needed for lineage assignment.
Separated by history of prior cytotoxic therapy rather than morphology.

60131.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中有一大團緊密聚集、大小一致的小圓形腫瘤細胞，並嵌在淡紫色纖維狀的基質（neuropil）中，與周圍血液及散在造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Large cohesive clump of small, uniform round tumor cells at low power
Tumor cells embedded in pale lilac, fibrillary background material consistent with neuropil
Cells have high N:C ratio and dark round nuclei; individual detail limited at this magnification
Surrounding blood-rich field with scattered dispersed hematopoietic cells
Note: image is a Wright-Giemsa aspirate smear rather than a trephine section
60131.describe_en: Low-power view of a Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive aggregate of small, uniform round tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios embedded in pale lilac fibrillary material consistent with neuropil. Surrounding areas contain blood and scattered hematopoietic cells. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. The presence of clumped small round cells with neuropil is consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed rather than clumped, lack neuropil, and are CD45/TdT positive, whereas neuroblastoma is CD45 negative and PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Rhabdomyosarcoma forms clusters with vacuolated cytoplasm but no neuropil, and expresses desmin and myogenin.
Ewing sarcoma shows PAS-positive vacuolated cells without neuropil, with CD99/NKX2.2 and EWSR1 rearrangement.
Marrow particles contain mixed hematopoietic lineages, fat and megakaryocytes rather than a monotonous small round cell population.

60067.recognize_zh: 普魯士藍鐵染色（核以紅色對比染色）下，許多紅血球系前驅細胞的核周圍排列著藍黑色鐵顆粒，部分呈半圈或環狀圍繞核，而非散在細胞質中；這就是環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts），是鐵粒母細胞性貧血的診斷依據。
features: Numerous erythroid precursors (small round red-counterstained nuclei) in the field
Blue-black siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear distribution, several encircling a third or more of the nuclear rim (ring sideroblasts)
Granules coarser and more numerous than in normal sideroblasts, which have 1-4 scattered fine granules
Additional precursors with fewer, non-ringed granules
Nuclear fast red counterstain; background red cells and scattered larger myeloid nuclei without iron
60067.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue and nuclear fast red counterstain shows numerous erythroid precursors, many of which contain coarse blue-black iron granules arranged in a perinuclear distribution. Several precursors have five or more granules encircling at least one-third of the nuclear circumference, meeting the definition of ring sideroblasts, while others contain fewer scattered granules. Stromal iron in macrophages is not assessable in this field. Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts, supporting sideroblastic anemia in this clinical context (congenital forms such as ALAS2-related X-linked sideroblastic anemia).

ddx.dx: MDS with ring sideroblasts / SF3B1 mutation
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts look identical; distinguished by age, multilineage dysplasia, SF3B1 mutation, and absence of germline ALAS2/SLC25A38 variants.

ddx.dx: Acquired reversible sideroblastosis (alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc toxicity, isoniazid, lead)
ddx.vs: Identical ring sideroblasts; history, drug exposure, copper/zinc and lead levels identify the reversible cause.
Normal sideroblasts contain only a few fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than a perinuclear ring.
Macrophage iron is extracellular/stromal clumps in large cells, and siderocytes are anucleate red cells with granules, not nucleated erythroid precursors.

28451.recognize_zh: 原始細胞胞質與核上布滿粗大、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒，部分覆蓋核而使核輪廓模糊，旁邊還有無顆粒、染色質細緻的原始細胞；高倍圖可見顆粒脫出於細胞邊緣（箭頭），符合急性嗜鹼性球白血病。
features: Medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin partially obscured by coarse dark purple-black basophilic granules overlying the nucleus and cytoplasm
Coexisting agranular blast with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and a rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm
Granules unevenly distributed, with focal degranulation/extrusion at the cell margin and a cytoplasmic protrusion (arrow, panel B)
Absence of mature segmented basophils in the field; background red cells unremarkable
28451.describe_en: Smear shows blasts with finely dispersed chromatin, many of which contain numerous coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules overlying both nucleus and cytoplasm, together with agranular blasts with scant pale basophilic cytoplasm. At high power, granules appear clustered at the cell periphery with focal extrusion from a cytoplasmic protrusion. Mature basophils and eosinophils are not prominent. Findings are suggestive of acute basophilic leukemia; confirmation requires metachromatic staining (toluidine blue positive), negative MPO, flow cytometry (CD123, CD203c, CD11b; CD117 negative) and exclusion of BCR::ABL1 and other defining genetic lesions.

ddx.vs: Mast cells also show metachromatic granules but are CD117-bright, tryptase-positive and CD25-positive, with oval nuclei and more evenly distributed granules.

ddx.dx: Blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia
ddx.vs: CML blast phase with basophilia arises with a chronic-phase history and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
APL granules are azurophilic (red-purple), MPO strongly positive with Auer rod bundles, and the cells carry PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) or t(6;9) with basophilia
ddx.vs: These AML types have basophilia accompanying other blasts with specific cytogenetics, so karyotype is required to exclude them.

27939.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下被片狀原始細胞取代，核卵圓或有凹陷、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，其間夾雜深染小圓核的紅血球前驅細胞與含嗜酸性顆粒的骨髓細胞，並有核分裂像，屬 AML 的組織學表現；CEBPA 突變須靠分子檢測確認。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with oval, focally indented or folded nuclei
Finely dispersed vesicular chromatin with small but visible nucleoli
Moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Scattered mitotic figures
Residual hematopoietic elements: small clusters of erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and scattered eosinophilic myelocytes
27939.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow largely replaced by sheets of medium-to-large blasts with oval to indented nuclei, fine vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, with scattered mitotic figures. Residual erythroid precursors and eosinophilic granulocytic cells are interspersed. Megakaryocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; subclassification as AML with CEBPA mutation depends on molecular testing, since the histology is not specific.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts are more monotonous with scant cytoplasm and lack admixed granulocytic differentiation, and are TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive and MPO negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with coarser chromatin and prominent nucleoli, express CD20/PAX5 and lack CD34/CD117/MPO.
MDS-IB shows <20% blasts with preserved dysplastic trilineage maturation, whereas blasts form sheets here (confirm by CD34 count and aspirate differential).
Monocytic blasts/promonocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and folded nuclei and express lysozyme, CD163 and CD14 rather than a granulocytic profile.

21731.recognize_zh: 五格骨髓紅血球母細胞並列比較：CDA I 為兩核之間有細長染色質橋（internuclear bridge）；CDA II 為雙核晚期紅血球母細胞；CDA III 為含多個核的巨大紅血球母細胞（gigantoblast）；變異型核形不規則。
features: CDA type I: erythroblasts connected by a thin internuclear chromatin bridge
CDA type II: late (polychromatic) erythroblast with two equal-sized round nuclei
CDA type III familial: giant erythroblast with several nuclei (up to 12 nuclei may occur)
CDA type III sporadic: large erythroblast with multiple tightly packed round nuclei
CDA variants: erythroblast with irregular, coarsely stippled nuclear chromatin and binuclearity
21731.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow aspirate erythroblasts illustrating the characteristic morphology of the congenital dyserythropoietic anemias. CDA type I is represented by erythroblasts joined by a fine internuclear chromatin bridge, CDA type II by a binucleated late erythroblast, and CDA type III by giant multinucleated erythroblasts (familial and sporadic forms). A variant shows an atypical binucleate erythroblast with abnormal chromatin. Findings illustrate the pathognomonic erythroblast morphology used to classify CDA, with confirmation by electron microscopy (spongy heterochromatin in type I, double membrane in type II) and genetic testing (CDAN1, SEC23B, KIF23).

ddx.vs: MDS occurs in older adults with multilineage dysplasia, clonal cytogenetics and often ring sideroblasts rather than lifelong isolated dyserythropoiesis.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin and hypersegmented neutrophils, correcting with B12 or folate.
Erythroid leukemia shows an increase in proerythroblasts (≥30%) with TP53 mutation rather than scattered binucleate late erythroblasts.
HS lacks binucleate or bridged erythroblasts, and the SDS-PAGE band 3 pattern and a negative HEMPAS acidified serum test separate it from CDA II.

15907.recognize_zh: 周邊血液的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）細胞質中除了細小嗜天青顆粒外，還有較大的粉紅至紫色棒狀或圓形包涵體；電子顯微鏡證實為巨大的平行管狀陣列（parallel tubular arrays），見於 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Upper panels (PB): medium-to-large lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Cytoplasm contains distinct, larger-than-usual pink-purple rod-shaped or globular inclusions in addition to fine azurophilic granules
Inclusions are few per cell and located near the nucleus or cell periphery
Lower panel (TEM): cytoplasmic stacks of long parallel tubular structures forming a giant parallel tubular array, adjacent to dense granules
Scale bar 10 µm; background red cells unremarkable
15907.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytes with moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm, round nuclei with condensed chromatin, and conspicuous large pink-purple rod-like to globular cytoplasmic inclusions in addition to fine azurophilic granules, consistent with large granular lymphocytes. Transmission electron microscopy of one such cell demonstrates an elongated bundle of densely packed parallel tubules (a giant parallel tubular array) alongside electron-dense granules. In a patient with rheumatoid arthritis and cytopenias, findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia with prominent parallel tubular arrays; clonality should be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD3+CD8+CD57+) and TCR gene rearrangement or STAT3 mutation analysis.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs are polyclonal and transient without persistent cytopenias; morphology overlaps and clonality testing is needed.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL proliferations are surface CD3 negative, CD16/CD56 positive and lack TCR rearrangement despite similar granular morphology.
CHS shows giant fused granules in all granulocytes and lymphocytes with albinism and immunodeficiency, and the inclusions are enlarged lysosomes rather than tubular arrays on EM.
Alder-Reilly granules are dense metachromatic mucopolysaccharide granules in neutrophils and other leukocytes in mucopolysaccharidoses, not rod-shaped inclusions restricted to LGLs.

15203.recognize_zh: 上肢可見大小不一、邊界清楚的紅色斑片與斑塊（蕈狀肉芽腫 IB 期）；背部則散布孤立的紅色小丘疹與結節，部分表面結痂或出血，會自行消退，符合合併淋巴瘤樣丘疹病（lymphomatoid papulosis）。
features: Panel A (arm): multiple erythematous to violaceous patches and slightly infiltrated plaques of variable size, some annular or coalescent
Plaques with scaly surfaces distributed along the extensor forearm and upper arm
Panel B (back): scattered discrete erythematous papules and small nodules
Several trunk papules with central crust, hemorrhagic or necrotic tops and small hyperpigmented residual macules, indicating different stages of evolution
Intervening trunk skin appears uninvolved by patches
15203.describe_en: Clinical photographs show, on the arm (panel A), multiple erythematous to violaceous scaly patches and plaques of varying size, consistent with mycosis fungoides. On the back (panel B), there are scattered discrete erythematous papules and small nodules in different stages of evolution, some with central crusts or hemorrhagic tops and others resolving as pigmented macules. No large ulcerated tumors are seen. Findings are consistent with coexisting mycosis fungoides (stage IB) and lymphomatoid papulosis; biopsy of a trunk papule would be expected to show CD30+ large atypical cells, and clonal relationship between the two can be assessed by TCR sequencing.

ddx.vs: Transformed MF produces persistent, enlarging tumors arising within plaques with >25% large cells, whereas LyP papules spontaneously regress within weeks.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: C-ALCL presents as solitary or grouped persistent nodules >2 cm that rarely regress completely, unlike recurrent self-healing crops of small papules.
PLEVA also shows crusted papules in crops but lacks CD30+ large atypical cells and is not associated with MF.
Bite reactions are grouped pruritic papules with eosinophil-rich wedge-shaped infiltrates that may contain CD30+ cells but lack a recurrent chronic course or associated MF.

15139.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E：濾泡小、生發中心萎縮並被同心圓狀排列的外套區細胞包圍（onion-skin），濾泡間富含血管與漿細胞，高倍下可見核大、核仁明顯的漿母細胞混在漿細胞之間，符合 HIV 相關多中心 Castleman 病（HHV8+ MCD）。
features: A: low power lymph node with preserved capsule and a small follicle with atrophic (regressed) germinal center and mildly expanded mantle zone
B: follicle with concentric onion-skin layering of mantle zone lymphocytes around a hyalinized/regressed germinal center
C: expanded interfollicular area with increased vascularity and a polymorphous plasmacytic infiltrate
D: high power showing sheets of mature plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei admixed with larger plasmablasts with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and amphophilic cytoplasm
No effacement of nodal architecture by confluent sheets of large cells
15139.describe_en: Lymph node sections (H&E) show preserved nodal architecture with a small follicle containing an atrophic, regressed germinal center and a mildly expanded mantle zone (A). At higher power, mantle zone lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers around the regressed germinal center (B). The interfollicular region is expanded by increased vascularity and a dense plasmacytic infiltrate (C), which at high power comprises mature plasma cells admixed with larger plasmablasts showing vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and amphophilic cytoplasm (D). Confluent sheets of large atypical cells are not seen. Findings are consistent with HIV-associated (HHV8-positive) multicentric Castleman disease; HHV8 LANA-1 immunostaining of mantle zone plasmablasts is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: iMCD shows similar regressed follicles and sheets of interfollicular plasma cells but lacks LANA-1-positive plasmablasts and occurs in HIV/HHV8-negative patients.
HIV lymphadenitis shows florid follicular hyperplasia with follicle lysis early and lymphocyte depletion late, without mantle zone LANA-1-positive plasmablasts.
Hyaline-vascular UCD is a localized mass with twin germinal centers, lollipop hyalinized vessels and prominent follicular dendritic cells, but lacks sheets of plasma cells and systemic symptoms.
IgG4-related disease shows increased IgG4+ plasma cells (IgG4/IgG ratio >40%) with elevated serum IgG4 and no HHV8 infection.

captions: A: Small follicle with atrophic germinal center and expanded mantle zone
B: Concentric onion-skin mantle zone around a regressed germinal center
C: Vascular interfollicular area with plasma cell infiltrate
D: Plasma cells and plasmablasts at high power

3107.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆大型組織球，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻、偶見小核仁，細胞質豐富、淡灰藍並帶細空泡，細胞間界線不清，周圍夾雜淋巴球與漿細胞，屬反應性組織球增生；此視野未見明確吞噬血球。
features: Several large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and ill-defined borders
Low N:C ratio with round to oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei
Fine, open chromatin with small nucleoli in some cells
No convincing intact phagocytosed hematopoietic cells in the histiocytes in this field
Background small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, a segmented neutrophil and red cells
3107.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli. The histiocytes appear cytologically bland without striated, foamy lipid-laden or crumpled cytoplasm. Definite hemophagocytosis is not seen in this field. Background lymphocytes, plasma cells and granulocytes are present. Findings are consistent with reactive histiocytosis; correlate clinically for infection, inflammation or evolving hemophagocytic syndrome.

ddx.vs: HLH requires histiocytes containing engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells, plus clinical criteria, which are not demonstrated in this field.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm with small eccentric nuclei, rather than finely vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia and prominent nucleoli, unlike these bland individual histiocytes.
Mast cells have dense purple metachromatic granules obscuring the nucleus, which are absent here.

3043.recognize_zh: 一團緊密黏合（cohesive）的大型細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍、細胞邊界互相貼合，核圓至卵圓且有明顯單一核仁，與周圍骨髓造血細胞完全不同，是轉移性癌細胞團的典型樣貌。
features: Cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large cells, much larger than surrounding red cells
Moderate to abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with cell-to-cell molding and distinct borders
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin
Prominent single nucleoli in many cells
Absence of hematopoietic features such as granules or perinuclear hof
3043.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a tightly cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells set against a background of red cells. The cells have moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm, molded cell borders, round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and conspicuous single nucleoli. No cytoplasmic granules or hematopoietic differentiation are evident. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; in the appropriate clinical context this supports metastatic prostatic adenocarcinoma, which can be confirmed by PSA/NKX3.1 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a pale perinuclear Golgi zone away from the nucleus and lack true cohesion and prominent atypical nucleoli.
A megakaryocyte is a single giant cell with a lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, not a cluster of separate molded cells.
Myeloma cells are discohesive with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, and express CD138 rather than cytokeratin.
Morphology cannot determine the primary; PSA/NKX3.1 positivity supports prostate origin.

2339.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆紅血球顏色較淡，內含不規則、伸出多條偽足狀藍色細絲的變形蟲樣（amoeboid）滋養體，並有紅色染色質點，這種分散不規則的滋養體是間日瘧（Plasmodium vivax）的特徵。
features: Single infected red cell that appears paler than surrounding erythrocytes
Intraerythrocytic parasite with irregular, spread-out amoeboid blue cytoplasm forming thin processes
Small magenta-red chromatin dot within the parasite
Schüffner stippling is not clearly resolved in this image
Surrounding red cells unremarkable; a single platelet is present
2339.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single pale red cell containing an amoeboid trophozoite with irregular, stringy blue cytoplasm and a red chromatin dot. The infected cell is not distinctly enlarged in this field, and Schüffner dots are not clearly resolved. No other parasitized cells, gametocytes or schizonts are present in this field. Findings are suggestive of Plasmodium vivax (amoeboid trophozoite); speciation should be confirmed by review of additional forms, rapid antigen testing or PCR, since P. ovale can appear similar.

ddx.vs: Infected cells are oval with fimbriated edges and the trophozoite is more compact, with prominent Schüffner-type (James) dots.
Shows small delicate rings, often multiple per cell with appliqué forms and banana-shaped gametocytes, in normal-sized cells without stippling.
Trophozoites are compact, forming band forms across normal-sized or small red cells.
Small pleomorphic rings, sometimes tetrads (Maltese cross), without pigment or amoeboid trophozoites.

1187.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有兩個圓形細胞，核圓且染色質粗塊狀、細胞質呈灰藍色（多染性），為循環中的有核紅血球（NRBC）；背景有多染性紅血球與小型緻密紅血球，提示溶血時的骨髓代償。
features: Two nucleated red cells with round nuclei and coarse, clumped chromatin
Gray-blue polychromatophilic cytoplasm, slightly more abundant in the upper cell (polychromatic normoblasts)
Large bluish polychromatophilic red cell (reticulocyte) in the background
Occasional small dense red cells lacking central pallor (spherocytes/microspherocytes)
Occasional crenated red cell and a teardrop-shaped cell; platelets present
1187.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating nucleated red cells with round, coarsely clumped nuclei and gray-blue polychromatophilic cytoplasm, consistent with polychromatic normoblasts. The background includes polychromatophilic macrocytic red cells and occasional small dense spherocytic cells, with a crenated cell and a teardrop form. No blasts are seen in this field. In a patient with hemolytic anemia, these findings reflect brisk erythropoietic response; correlation with reticulocyte count and hemolysis workup is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of clear sky-blue cytoplasm and less densely clumped chromatin, whereas NRBCs have gray-blue hemoglobinized cytoplasm with checkerboard chromatin.
Leukoerythroblastosis combines NRBCs with immature granulocytes and teardrop cells without evidence of hemolysis such as spherocytes and polychromasia.
Megaloblastic NRBCs are larger with open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, accompanied by macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils.

1123.recognize_zh: 一顆巨噬細胞內塞滿數百個 2–4 µm 的小卵圓形酵母菌，每個有偏心的新月形紫色核與周圍清亮暈圈（halo），這是莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）的典型樣貌。
features: Macrophage distended by innumerable small (2-4 µm) oval yeast forms
Each organism with a crescent-shaped purple nuclear cap and surrounding clear halo
Uniform size without budding hyphae or capsule
Displaced macrophage nucleus at the edge of the cell
Background red cells and a single lymphocyte
1123.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage packed with numerous small, uniform oval intracellular yeast forms measuring approximately 2-4 µm. Each organism has an eccentric crescent of basophilic nuclear material and a surrounding clear halo; no kinetoplasts are identified. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); confirmation with GMS/PAS stains, culture or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and are more elongated/sausage-shaped.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic without halos and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular in foamy exudate; GMS morphology helps separate them.
Candida is larger, stains less crisply on Wright stain, and may show pseudohyphae; culture separates them.

1059.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑增粗、交錯吻合（osteosclerosis），小樑間正常造血消失，被纖維化基質與成巢的淡染空泡狀細胞取代，這種造骨性反應加上骨髓被取代，提示轉移性前列腺癌。
features: Thickened, irregular anastomosing bony trabeculae consistent with osteoblastic (osteosclerotic) reaction
Intertrabecular marrow replaced by desmoplastic fibrous stroma
Nests and sheets of pale, clear to vacuolated cells with small nuclei
Loss of normal hematopoietic elements and fat
Carcinoma cytologic detail limited at this low magnification
1059.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at low power shows thickened, anastomosing bony trabeculae indicating an osteosclerotic reaction. The intertrabecular spaces are replaced by fibrous stroma containing nests of pale, vacuolated cells, with loss of normal hematopoiesis and fat. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of metastatic carcinoma with osteoblastic response, in keeping with prostatic origin; confirmation with pan-keratin, PSA and NKX3.1 immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes within fibrotic marrow and no keratin-positive epithelial nests.
Breast carcinoma can also be osteoblastic but is GATA3/ER positive and PSA/NKX3.1 negative.
Foamy histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive and keratin negative, without a desmoplastic cohesive nested pattern.

4067.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片低倍下，大量小至中型、核圓且染色質緻密、細胞質稀少嗜鹼性的淋巴球取代造血細胞；此倍率看不清細胞質突起或核仁，T-PLL 需依靠流式與 TCL1 檢測確認。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by small to medium lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin
Scant, basophilic cytoplasm in many cells
Reduced residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Low magnification limits assessment of nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs
4067.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low magnification shows a cellular specimen extensively infiltrated by small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, with reduced residual hematopoiesis. Fine cytologic details such as nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs are not resolvable at this power. Findings indicate marrow infiltration by a mature lymphoproliferative neoplasm and are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD5+/CD23+ B cells with soccer-ball chromatin, whereas T-PLL is a CD7-bright T-cell neoplasm with TCL1 overexpression.
Lymphoblasts have fine immature chromatin and are TdT/CD34 positive.
ATLL cells show polylobated nuclei and HTLV-1 positivity with CD25 expression.

4131.recognize_zh: 低倍下大片充血的粉紅色紅髓（red pulp）中，散在一個藍紫色、界線清楚的圓形淋巴組織（白髓，white pulp），比例與結構正常，是正常脾臟的切片。
features: Low-power field dominated by congested red pulp with cords and sinusoids
Discrete round basophilic white pulp nodule of small lymphocytes near the center
White pulp is small and well demarcated, without expansion or confluence
Additional ill-defined lymphoid collections at the periphery of the field
No nodules, fibrosis, granulomas, or infiltrates identifiable at this magnification
4131.describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows abundant congested red pulp composed of splenic cords and sinusoids. A small, well-circumscribed white pulp nodule composed of small lymphocytes is present, with normal size and distribution. No expansion of the white pulp, red pulp infiltrate, granulomas, or mass lesion is seen at this magnification, although cytologic detail is limited. Findings are consistent with normal splenic architecture.

ddx.vs: Shows enlarged, often confluent white pulp nodules with a biphasic pale marginal zone and red pulp involvement, unlike the small single nodule here.
Diffusely expands red pulp with monotonous cells and blood lakes while atrophying white pulp, which requires higher power and CD20/annexin A1 to recognize.
Features dilated sinuses and cord fibrosis with Gamna-Gandy bodies, which are not evident here.

4003.recognize_zh: 箭頭標示一顆有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），旁邊有兩顆核摺疊、細胞質灰藍的單核球；兒童血液中單核球增多又見有核紅血球，是幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）常見的周邊血表現。
features: Arrow: nucleated red blood cell with small round pyknotic nucleus and orthochromatic cytoplasm
Two large monocytes with indented/folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Partial neutrophil at left edge with segmented nucleus
Red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, occasional stomatocyte-like and target forms
No blasts in this field
4003.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a circulating nucleated red blood cell (arrow) adjacent to two monocytes with folded nuclei and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm. A segmented neutrophil is present at the edge of the field. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis; no blasts are seen in this field. In a young child, monocytosis with circulating nucleated red cells is suggestive of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic context.

ddx.vs: A leukoerythroblastic picture shows NRBCs with immature granulocytes and teardrop cells rather than a dominant monocytosis.

ddx.dx: Reactive monocytosis with hemolysis or stress erythropoiesis
ddx.vs: Reactive states can produce NRBCs and monocytes, but lack persistent monocytosis above 1 x 10^9/L with splenomegaly, elevated HbF and RAS-pathway mutations.
CMML is morphologically similar but occurs in older adults and lacks the prominent NRBCs and HbF elevation typical of JMML.

3747.recognize_zh: 這顆巨核細胞體積很大、細胞質豐富且呈顆粒狀，但核只有一個卵圓形、不分葉的核（unilobed），周圍嗜中性球可作大小對照，常見於 5q 缺失的骨髓增生不良。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Single round-to-oval, non-lobated nucleus with dense, finely clumped chromatin
Abundant, finely granular basophilic-to-lilac cytoplasm with a paler peripheral zone
Low N:C ratio, indicating a mature megakaryocyte despite the unilobed nucleus
Surrounding neutrophils, band forms and lymphocytes in an aspirate background
3747.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a single round-to-oval, non-lobated nucleus. The cell size and cytoplasmic maturity indicate a mature megakaryocyte rather than a micromegakaryocyte. Adjacent granulocytes appear unremarkable in this field. Findings represent a unilobed (monolobated) megakaryocyte, a dysplastic feature classically associated with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q); cytogenetic studies are recommended if such forms are numerous.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small (neutrophil-sized or less) with scant cytoplasm, unlike this large cell with abundant cytoplasm.
Immature forms have high N:C ratio and basophilic agranular cytoplasm rather than abundant granular cytoplasm.
Osteoclasts contain multiple separate round nuclei rather than a single unilobed nucleus.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes
ddx.vs: Separated lobes appear as multiple discrete nuclei, whereas this cell has a single compact nucleus.

3619.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小正常，但有些紅血球裡有多個細小環狀體（ring form），其中一顆裡有三個環，還看得到雙染色質點（double chromatin dot）和貼在紅血球邊緣的貼附型（appliqué form）；這些線索指向惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）。
features: Multiple delicate ring-form trophozoites within normal-sized, non-enlarged RBCs
Multiply infected RBCs (one cell contains three rings)
Double chromatin dots and appliqué (accolé) forms at the RBC margin
Occasional slightly more mature trophozoite with denser cytoplasm and dark pigment
No Schüffner stippling; no schizonts or crescent gametocytes in this field
Background platelets adequate; one platelet clump in center
3619.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous RBCs infected by small, delicate ring-form trophozoites. Infected RBCs are normal in size without stippling, and several contain two or three parasites, with double chromatin dots and appliqué forms at the cell margin. A few slightly more mature trophozoites with dark pigment are present; schizonts and gametocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum infection; parasitemia should be quantified.

ddx.vs: Infected RBCs are enlarged with Schüffner stippling and amoeboid trophozoites or schizonts, and multiply infected cells are uncommon.
Tiny pleomorphic rings without hemozoin pigment and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms, with a travel/tick history rather than malaria exposure.
Early rings can look identical, but band-form trophozoites and mature schizonts in circulation favor knowlesi, and PCR is needed to separate them.
A superimposed platelet lacks a ring of cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot and usually shows a halo and granular texture.

3491.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞一端伸出一條細胞質尾巴（uropod），形狀像手持鏡子（hand mirror cells），核質比高、染色質細緻；此形態可見於急性白血病（淋巴芽細胞較常見），但不具譜系特異性。
features: Immature mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio and finely granular chromatin
Unipolar cytoplasmic projection (uropod) producing a hand-mirror shape (arrows)
Scant basophilic cytoplasm concentrated in the tail region
Several other cells with similar polarized cytoplasm; one small cell with dense chromatin
Background red cells with an erythrocyte containing small refractile inclusions
3491.describe_en: Smear shows several immature mononuclear cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and finely granular chromatin. Many display a unipolar tail of basophilic cytoplasm (uropod), imparting a hand-mirror configuration, as highlighted by the arrows. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are not seen. Findings are consistent with hand mirror cells, a nonspecific morphologic variant most often seen in acute lymphoblastic leukemia but also in other acute leukemias; lineage requires flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Crush artifact produces smeared, streaming nuclear chromatin without an intact nucleus and discrete cytoplasmic tail.
Megakaryoblasts show multiple peripheral blebs rather than a single uropod, and are CD41/CD61 positive.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and perinuclear hof, and more abundant uniformly blue cytoplasm.

3427.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中淋巴細胞明顯增多，多為中型、核不規則有凹陷或切跡、細胞質少至中量淡藍，比典型「臀部細胞（buttock cell）」更大、染色質較開放，符合型態非典型的周邊血液化濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Marked absolute lymphocytosis with numerous atypical lymphoid cells in a low-power field
Cells small-to-intermediate, many larger than typical small lymphocytes
Nuclei irregular with notches, clefts or indentations; some angulated
Chromatin moderately condensed to somewhat open; nucleoli inconspicuous at this power
Scant-to-moderate pale blue cytoplasm; background red cells largely normocytic with few smudge-like forms
3427.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small-to-intermediate atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, notched and focally cleaved nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant-to-moderate pale blue cytoplasm. Many cells are larger and less condensed than the classic small cleaved buttock cells of follicular lymphoma. Red cells are largely unremarkable and platelets are present. Findings are suggestive of leukemic involvement by a B-cell lymphoma with atypical morphology, consistent with peripheralizing follicular lymphoma in the appropriate context; flow cytometry (CD10+, CD5-, bright sIg) and t(14;18) IGH::BCL2 testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have similar irregular nuclei but are CD5+, CD10-, cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14).
CLL cells are round-nucleated with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5/CD23 positive with dim sIg.
Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and ATLL cells have flower-like lobation, both with a CD4+ T-cell phenotype.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in blood
ddx.vs: Leukemic DLBCL shows larger cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm.

3299.recognize_zh: 血片中四顆小型淋巴細胞，核圓或橢圓、染色質濃密，細胞質少量深藍，並在兩端伸出短而細的絨毛狀突起（bipolar villi），這是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤絨毛狀淋巴細胞的典型外觀。
features: Small lymphocytes, only slightly larger than red cells
Round to oval nuclei with dense, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleoli
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Short, fine villous projections concentrated at one or both poles of the cell
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking; a platelet clump and partial neutrophil at edge
3299.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, dense clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli, and scant basophilic cytoplasm bearing short, fine villous projections concentrated at the cell poles. Red cells show mild rouleaux-like stacking and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with villous lymphocytes of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; flow cytometry demonstrating a CD5-, CD10-, CD103-, CD25- clonal B-cell population is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells are larger with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential fine projections, oval to bean-shaped nuclei, and are CD103/CD25/annexin A1 positive.
CLL cells lack polar villi and are CD5/CD23 positive with dim surface immunoglobulin.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells show broad-based, often uneven villi and require splenic histology and cyclin D3 expression to separate from SMZL.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and an IgM paraprotein with MYD88 L265P, without polar villi.

3363.recognize_zh: 低倍率骨髓抽吸抹片細胞量豐富，除了三系造血細胞外，散布許多體積大、細胞質淡藍灰且帶空泡或泡沫狀的組織球（histiocytes），在細胞密集處特別顯眼；組織球數目明顯增加即為骨髓組織球增生。
features: Cellular aspirate with abundant hematopoietic cells and scattered fat spaces
Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue foamy to vacuolated cytoplasm
Histiocytes have small round to oval eccentric nuclei
Background trilineage hematopoiesis including granulocytic, erythroid and lymphoid cells
Low magnification precludes assessment of hemophagocytosis or intracellular organisms
3363.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power is cellular, with trilineage hematopoiesis and scattered fat spaces. Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue, foamy to vacuolated cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei are distributed throughout the smear, most conspicuous in cellular areas. Hemophagocytosis, pigment or intracellular organisms cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow histiocytosis; high-power review for hemophagocytosis and organisms, iron stain and special stains for microorganisms, and clinical correlation (infection, storage disorder, HLH) are recommended.

ddx.vs: HLH requires histiocytes engulfing intact red cells, neutrophils or nucleated cells on high-power review, together with clinical and laboratory criteria.
Gaucher cells have fibrillar crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm rather than foamy vacuolation and show low glucocerebrosidase activity.
These storage histiocytes have uniform soap-bubble lipid vacuoles or sea-blue granules on high power.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio and atypical nuclei, unlike dispersed bland histiocytes.

3235.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中見一顆含五個核的大型漿細胞，細胞質深藍、核染色質較細緻開放，旁邊兩顆單核細胞也有偏心核與深藍細胞質，顯示不成熟、多核的腫瘤性漿細胞。
features: Large multinucleated plasma cell with five separate round nuclei
Abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler central zone
Nuclei with relatively fine, open chromatin rather than clock-face clumping
Two adjacent mononuclear plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm; one with a small vacuole
Clean body-fluid background with scattered red cells and echinocytes
3235.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows atypical plasma cells, including a large multinucleated form with five round nuclei embedded in abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The nuclei have relatively fine chromatin, indicating immaturity. Two adjacent mononuclear cells show eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm consistent with plasma cells. Findings are consistent with a malignant pleural effusion involved by a plasma cell neoplasm (myelomatous effusion); confirmation with CD138 and light-chain restriction studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, dense two-tone cytoplasm with a peripheral brush border or windows and are calretinin+ CD138-, not eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof.
Carcinoma forms cohesive three-dimensional clusters and is keratin+, whereas these cells are discohesive plasmacytoid cells with basophilic cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma / DLBCL with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma shows larger blasts with prominent central nucleoli, high Ki-67 and often EBER positivity, and lacks a clinical myeloma context.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, mononuclear and polytypic, whereas multinucleation and immature chromatin favor neoplasia.

3171.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中大量標靶紅血球（target cell），並夾雜數個有直邊、折疊或一端突起的緻密紅血球，但沒有典型細長鐮刀形細胞，這種組合提示血紅素SC病。
features: Numerous target cells with central hemoglobinized dot and surrounding pale ring
Occasional dense, folded or angular red cells with straight edges
Some red cells with irregularly distributed hemoglobin or knob-like projections
Absence of classic elongated sickle cells in this field
Mild anisocytosis; a few small dense cells and platelets
3171.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells accompanied by occasional dense, folded red cells with straight or angular edges and cells with unevenly distributed hemoglobin. Classic sickle cells and discrete intraerythrocytic crystals are not clearly identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of hemoglobin SC disease; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required.

ddx.vs: HbCC shows abundant target cells, spherocytes and rhomboid HbC crystals but lacks the folded SC cells and sickle forms; HPLC shows no HbS.
HbSS shows many elongated sickle cells, Howell-Jolly bodies and nucleated red cells, with fewer target cells.

ddx.dx: Thalassemia or liver disease with target cells
ddx.vs: Target cells in thalassemia are accompanied by microcytosis and basophilic stippling, and in liver disease by macrocytosis, without folded or crystal-containing cells.

2979.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆嗜中性球的細胞質內可見數顆大而不規則、灰紫色的包涵顆粒，明顯大於正常顆粒，是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的巨大顆粒。
features: Mature neutrophil with a band-to-segmented, C-shaped nucleus
Several large, irregular gray-purple cytoplasmic inclusions (giant granules)
Remaining cytoplasm pale with few normal granules
Background red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
Isolated leukocyte in field, suggesting low neutrophil count (not quantifiable here)
2979.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells and a single neutrophil. The neutrophil contains several coarse, irregular gray-purple cytoplasmic inclusions that are much larger than normal specific or toxic granules. No Döhle bodies or vacuolation are evident. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Döhle and May-Hegglin inclusions are pale blue, peripheral, spindle-shaped and associated with giant platelets rather than purple granular inclusions.
Toxic granules are fine, dark and evenly distributed, not few large irregular bodies.
Seen in AML/MDS with accompanying dysplasia or blasts, whereas CHS is congenital with albinism.

2723.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見中型母細胞：核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少呈淡藍，旁邊有一顆小型成熟淋巴球與一顆有核紅血球作比較；在此倍率下細胞質顆粒並不明顯，顆粒型 ALL 的特徵需高倍確認。
features: Intermediate-sized blasts with round nuclei and fine, dispersed chromatin
High N:C ratio with a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic azurophilic granules not clearly resolved at this magnification
A second, smaller cell with slightly more condensed chromatin (upper left), possibly a smaller blast
Mature small lymphocyte and a nucleated red blood cell present for comparison
2723.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating intermediate-sized blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm. A mature small lymphocyte and a nucleated red blood cell are present for size comparison. Cytoplasmic azurophilic granules, which define granular ALL, are not clearly resolved at this magnification, and Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with circulating blasts compatible with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry are necessary, particularly to exclude AML in a granular blast population.

ddx.vs: Granulated blasts raise concern for AML; MPO negativity and B-lineage markers (CD19, CD79a, TdT) establish granular ALL.
Hematogones and reactive lymphocytes show more condensed chromatin or abundant cytoplasm and are not a leukemic population with cytopenias.

ddx.dx: Blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia (lymphoid)
ddx.vs: Lymphoid blast phase has a background of basophilia and left-shifted granulocytes with BCR::ABL1 fusion.

2403.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，箭頭指向脂肪空泡旁一顆大型、深藍色細胞質的細胞，另在中下方可見一顆大而淡藍的細胞；在大量小型造血細胞中找這種明顯較大的藍色細胞，是辨認骨髓瘤大型漿細胞的第一步。
features: Low-power aspirate with abundant fat vacuoles and a cellular background
Arrow marks a large cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm at the edge of a fat vacuole
Additional scattered large cells with pale to deep blue cytoplasm in the cellular trails
Background of numerous small maturing hematopoietic cells and red cells
Fine morphologic detail not resolvable at this magnification
2403.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous fat vacuoles and trails of maturing hematopoietic cells. Scattered large cells with abundant blue cytoplasm are present, one of which is indicated by the arrow adjacent to a fat vacuole. Nuclear features cannot be assessed at this power, and higher magnification is required to confirm plasma cell identity. In context, these large cells are compatible with atypical plasma cells of plasma cell myeloma; a differential count and clonality studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are larger with lobulated nuclei and granular lilac cytoplasm, visible at higher power, rather than homogeneous deep blue cytoplasm.
Histiocytes have pale, vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytosed debris rather than intensely basophilic homogeneous cytoplasm.
Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, often perivascular and polytypic, without large atypical forms or light chain restriction.

2019.recognize_zh: 這是一張免疫組織化學染色：一條帶狀區域的細胞呈紅棕色細胞膜／細胞質網狀陽性，細胞質豐富、排列成片；未標註染色抗體、復染極淡，推測是標示竇內單核樣 B 細胞或組織球，但無法僅憑此圖確定。
features: Immunohistochemical stain with red-brown chromogen and very faint counterstain
Band-like zone of cells with membranous/cytoplasmic reticular positivity
Positive cells have abundant pale cytoplasm and are arranged in sheets
Adjacent areas largely negative
Nuclear detail not assessable owing to weak counterstain and image quality
2019.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antibody not specified) shows a band-like zone of cells with abundant pale cytoplasm displaying membranous and reticular cytoplasmic positivity, with largely negative adjacent tissue. The counterstain is faint and nuclear morphology cannot be assessed. The distribution suggests highlighting of a sinusoidal population such as monocytoid B cells or histiocytes in toxoplasma lymphadenitis, but the specific marker and cell type cannot be determined from this image alone; no organisms are identifiable.

ddx.vs: Monocytoid B cells show membranous CD20 in sinus-distributed cells with clear cytoplasm, whereas histiocytes would be CD20 negative and CD68/CD163 positive.
Histiocytic markers give granular cytoplasmic staining in cells with abundant pink cytoplasm on H&E, which requires the paired H&E and marker identity to confirm.
Lymphoma would show confluent CD20-positive monocytoid sheets effacing the node with light chain restriction rather than a sinusoidal band in a reactive node.

1955.recognize_zh: 高倍下見多形性浸潤：小淋巴球、胞質淡染或透明的中型細胞、帶泡狀核與核仁的大型免疫母細胞，加上散在的嗜酸性球與漿細胞；上方中央有管壁粉紅玻璃樣化的分支小血管（HEV），這種「多種細胞混雜加上血管增生」是 AITL 的特徵。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, medium-sized atypical cells with pale to clear cytoplasm, and scattered large immunoblasts
Large cells with vesicular chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and visible nucleoli
Branching vessel with plump endothelial cells and eosinophilic hyalinized wall (high endothelial venule) at upper center
Scattered eosinophils and plasma cells in the background
Pale eosinophilic intercellular material between the cells
1955.describe_en: High-power section shows a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with pale to clear cytoplasm, and scattered large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli. Eosinophils and plasma cells are admixed, and a branching high endothelial venule with plump endothelium and a hyalinized eosinophilic wall is present. Pale intercellular eosinophilic material is noted. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; confirmation with TFH markers, CD21 for expanded FDC meshworks, and T-cell receptor gene rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: cHL contains diagnostic CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells, whereas the large cells in AITL are a mix of EBV-positive B immunoblasts and TFH-phenotype T cells.
PTCL-NOS lacks the TFH immunophenotype (PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS) and the expanded perivascular FDC meshworks characteristic of AITL.
Reactive paracortical expansions preserve architecture and lack clear-cell TFH clusters and clonal TCR rearrangement.

1763.recognize_zh: CD30免疫染色中，強陽性（棕色）的大型細胞密集排列在淋巴結被膜下竇（subcapsular sinus）並沿竇道向內延伸，呈現間變性大細胞淋巴瘤典型的竇內浸潤模式。
features: Strong CD30 membranous and paranuclear dot-like (Golgi) staining in large cells
Dense band of CD30-positive cells lining the subcapsular sinus just beneath the fibrous capsule
Additional positive cells tracking into interfollicular and medullary sinuses
Background small lymphocytes negative (blue counterstain)
Fibrous capsule at top without staining
1763.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry on a lymph node shows strong membranous and Golgi-pattern staining in large cells concentrated within the subcapsular sinus beneath the capsule, with additional positive cells extending into deeper sinuses. The background small lymphocytes are negative. This sinusoidal distribution of strongly and uniformly CD30-positive large cells is characteristic. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; ALK immunostaining is needed to classify it as ALK-positive or ALK-negative.

ddx.vs: Sinusoidal carcinoma is keratin positive and generally CD30 negative (except embryonal carcinoma).
CD30-positive Hodgkin cells are scattered singly in a mixed background rather than packing sinuses, and are CD15 and weak PAX5 positive.
Reactive immunoblasts are scattered in interfollicular areas with variable weaker staining rather than forming cohesive sinus-filling sheets.
Sinus histiocytes fill sinuses but are CD30 negative and CD68/CD163 positive.

1699.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片被一片單調、大小相近的中型母細胞佔滿，核圓、細胞質極少，正常造血細胞幾乎不見；右側可見被推擠破裂的細胞（smudge）拉出染色質。
features: Monotonous sheet of medium-sized blasts effacing normal hematopoiesis
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Homogeneous fine chromatin; nucleoli not resolvable at this magnification
Crushed/smudged cells with streaming chromatin at the right edge
Interspersed red cells distorted by smear preparation
1699.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate magnification shows a monotonous, densely packed population of medium-sized blasts with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with near-complete replacement of normal maturing elements. Crushed cells with streaming chromatin are present along the right side of the field. Granules and Auer rods cannot be assessed reliably at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry.
