ddx.vs: Shares the monotonous high N:C appearance; distinguished only by lymphoid lineage markers with negative MPO.
Higher-power review may reveal Auer rods or fine granules and MPO positivity in the blasts.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clumps or rosettes and are CD45-negative, whereas leukemic blasts are discohesive and CD45-positive.

1635.recognize_zh: 淡染的中型細胞聚成一大片，核圓、染色質開放、可見小核仁，細胞質淡粉，其間散在凋亡小體，邊緣被深染小淋巴球包圍；屬淋巴結中反應性淡染區（如生發中心），細胞並非單一型態的腫瘤片狀排列。
features: Nodular pale area of medium-sized cells with round vesicular nuclei and small distinct nucleoli
Moderate pale cytoplasm with fairly distinct cell outlines
Scattered apoptotic bodies and occasional mitotic figures
Small dark lymphocytes at the periphery (left and upper right)
Delicate vessels and scattered elongated stromal cells
1635.describe_en: Section of lymph node at medium power shows a pale nodular area composed of medium-sized cells with round vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, with scattered apoptotic bodies and occasional mitoses. The area is bordered by small dark lymphocytes. Without immunostains, the pale nodule is best interpreted as a reactive compartment such as a germinal center; the absence of a clear mantle in this field limits interpretation. Findings are consistent with normal/reactive lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are dominated by cleaved centrocytes with few tingible body macrophages and are BCL2 positive, whereas this nodule contains apoptotic debris and mitoses of a reactive center.
Monocytoid B-cell clusters have more abundant clear cytoplasm and bean-shaped nuclei with admixed neutrophils in a perisinusoidal distribution.
DLBCL forms diffuse sheets of large atypical cells effacing the architecture, whereas the cells here are medium-sized and confined to a nodule bordered by small lymphocytes.

99.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構保留，但有數個特別大、邊界不清的濾泡；免疫染色可見外套區小淋巴球長入並把生發中心切成碎塊，生發中心標記只剩散在的小群聚，這種結構符合生發中心進行性轉化（PTGC）。
features: Preserved nodal architecture with a few markedly enlarged, expansile follicles several times the size of adjacent reactive follicles
Blurred follicle borders on H&E with small mantle-type lymphocytes infiltrating the follicle
IHC highlights mantle-zone B cells extending into and replacing the follicle center
Germinal-center cells reduced to scattered, fragmented clusters within the enlarged follicle
Interfollicular T-zone and smaller secondary follicles with intact germinal centers and mantle zones nearby
No diffuse effacement or monotonous neoplastic nodules evident at this power
99.describe_en: Sections of the lymph node show preserved architecture with reactive-appearing secondary follicles and several markedly enlarged follicles with indistinct borders. On immunohistochemistry, small mantle-zone B cells extend into these follicles and break the germinal centers into small, irregular residual clusters, while the adjacent smaller follicles retain normal germinal centers with intact mantle cuffs. The interfollicular T-zone is preserved. The stains are not labeled in these images, and the fragments of germinal-center cells are best seen on the nuclear stains. Large atypical lymphocyte-predominant cells cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules efface the architecture and contain scattered large CD20+/OCT2+ LP (popcorn) cells rimmed by PD-1+ T cells, whereas PTGC has preserved architecture, lacks LP cells, and shows an even distribution of follicular helper T cells.
Hyperplastic follicles keep sharp germinal centers with polarization, tingible-body macrophages and a crisp mantle cuff, without mantle-cell ingrowth fragmenting the follicle center.

FL shows back-to-back monotonous follicles lacking polarization and mantle zones, with BCL2-positive germinal-center cells, rather than few enlarged follicles containing BCL2-negative germinal-center fragments.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone or nodular pattern
ddx.vs: MCL is a monotonous cyclin D1+/SOX11+, CD5+ B-cell proliferation expanding the mantles, whereas the ingrowing mantle cells in PTGC are polytypic, IgD+ and cyclin D1-negative.
